dkon brtsegs/ (khri (41)0073 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u/(smad) 3lnga pa/ btang snyoms kyi le'u/ 123drug pa/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 141bdun pa/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 154brgyad pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 237dgu pa/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 250bcu pa/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 351bcu gcig pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 383rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya su ren dra dang /shrī len dra dang / ā tsār+ya rnyarma tā shī las bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/1

bsdur mchan/(500 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(636)0074 'phags pa dga' bo la mngal na gnas pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 637bsdur mchan/(716) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)0075 'phags pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 737bsdur mchan/(767) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(7770076 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 775rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo rnyi dang /dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(892) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(912)2 ri

༄ ༄myanganamanabral nga rgyan kunalardulabrala' ga na dubyu byu /༄de she sgo ko 'i tsho zhe co sgo 'i'ob rag gas bsapab dpa dpal // 'a ba sa ba ma ldan bas pa da/ /

༄ga /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄tshog / 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/② bam po bzhi pa②/ shākyiri'i bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'odakyibasam gyis misnyikhyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /the tshomatumi za/ rgya cherashedaga' mgu stekhyi/ rangs pa rnyed cing ngo mtshar dang rmad dulo'adu shes skyed7ce na/ 'di la shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi dbyings rab tu rtogs te/ de rab tu rtogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mngon par gshegs nas lamasame/ lhan ne/lhang7nger mdzad do/ /dene'adi lta ste dper na sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la nyi ma mngon par shar nas lam me lhan de⑩/ lhang nge ba desnyibazhin du shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang hu)41—3

stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 3)'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mngon par gshegs nas lam pame/ lhan nel / lhang nger mdzad do/ /shā ri'i bu srin bu me khyer0gyi 'od de rabs ni gang 'bru50mar gyi mar me'i 'od 'di shin tu 'phags/ shin tu mchogamo /shin tu kha dog dang ldan/ shin tu 'od gsal/ shin tu rgya che'o//'bru shesamar gyi mar me'i 'od deshebs ni rtsig pa chen po'i 'od 'dinyeshin tu 'phags / shin tu mchog pa nas shin tu rgya che ba'i bar du'o/ /gang rtsig7pa chen po'i 'od de nya4bas ni tunyeme'i phung po chen po'i 'od gang yin pa dang tunye/sman dang skar ma'i 'od gang yin pa'i bar durwanyergyas par bya stenya/ zla ba'i 'od dang ske/ nyi ma'i 'od dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi 'odapocadang /gzhal med khang dang / lus kyi rgyan rnams dang / de bzhin du sum cu du nye rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral5 )ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang ske/ 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi ra ba dang / gzhal med khang dang / lus kyi rgyan rnams dang / gang tshangs pa rnams dang / tshangs ris pa rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don zhunyepa rnams dang / tshangs5 snye'akhor ba rnams dang / tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyi ra ba dang ske/ gzhal med khang dang / lus kyi rgyan rnams kyi 'od 'di shin tu 'phags/ shin tu bzang / shin tu mchog /shin tu kha dog dang ldan/ shin tu 'od gsal/ shin tu rgya che'o/ /gang tshangs pa rnams dang / tshangs ris pa rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don du sepa rnams dang / tshangs bu'akhor ba rnams dang / tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyi 'od kyang rgyas par bya stekhi 7/ 'od chen nisnyedang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal nas ⑦/41—4

dge rgyas kyi bar dang / 'bras bu che7dang / 'du shes can dang / 'du shes med pa dang /② 'du shes med 'du shes med min dang / mi che ba dang /mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang bsnyedang / shin tu mthong gi ra ba dang /gzhal med khang dang / lus kyi 'od dang / gang 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi ra ba dngasnyi/ gzhal med khang rnams dang / lus kyi 'od 'di shin tu 'phags/shin tu bzang / shin tu mchog /shin tu kha dog dang ldan shin tu 'od gsal/shin tu rgya che'o/ /gang 'og min gyi0lha rnams kyi ra ba dang / gzhal med khang rnams dang / lus kyi 'od ⑦bas ni gang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'od 'di shin tu 'phags/ shin tu bzang ske/ shin tu mchog /shin tu kha dog dang ldan shin tu 'od gsal/ shin tu rgya che'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa tshul khrims dpag tu med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa dang / shes rab dpag tu med pa dang / rnam par grol ba dpag tu med pa dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba dpag tu med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu ji tsam stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'od tu btags pa gdags pas btagasalgepa de thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi brgya yi7char yang nye bar mi 'gro bsnye nas/ rgyu'itshwanyebar du yang nye b.ranyemi 'gro'o8//de 'di lta ste dper na/ shā ri'i bu 'dzam bu chu bo'i tsogaser gyi nang du gser tha mal hunyepa gzhag tunyen snag tsha'i gar bu bzhin du tu)'gyur te lam mer mi 'gyur/lhan der mi 'gyur/ lhang nger mi 'gyur ro'i/ /de bzhin du shā ri'i bu ⑩stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na 'od 0 tu gdags pas 41—5

btags pa ji snyed yod pa ①de ②thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi mdun na lam mer mi 'gyur/ lhan ner mi 'gyur/ lhang nger mi 'gyur rol/ /'od gsal bar mi 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od ni de dag gi nang na mchog ces bya/ dmasapa zhes bya/ bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i yinyi tshe ba'i 'od ⑦las kyi nirnam par smin pa las mngon par grub pa'i 'od des7kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang bas shin tu khyab ⑩par 'gyur teyi/ shā ri'i bu zla ba dang nyi ma'i 'od kyis7snang ba yang mi 'byungs/ nyin mor yang mi shes/ mtshan mor yang mi shes/ zla ba phyed yidang / zla ba gcig par yang mi shes/ dus dang loratsoyang mi shes mod kyi/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas sems can la thugs brtse tshuba'i phyir 'od 'dom gang tsam du tunyebyin gyis rlob 8ste/ shā ri'i bu yide bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhed na 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa 'od kyis khyab par mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'ikhudam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes par 1ste/ shā ri'i bu don de nyid rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir khyod shel dpe bstan to/ /shā ri'i bu skyes bu la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul ji snyed pa thams cad rdul phra rab tu dgebyas nas rdul de dag thu bar blugs te/ shar phyogs su song nas rdul phra mo de 3 ji snyed pa de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi (nyekhams 'das nas/rdul phra rab gnyis pa tsobor zhing shar phyogs su song na/ shā ri'i bu rdul phra rab de thams cad ni zad par 'gyur gyis(7/ shā ri'i bu shar phyogs skye/ 'jig rten 41—6

gyi khams ni zad pa med do/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang nas phyogs bcu kun gyi bar du'o/ /shā ri'i bu de ji snyam du sems/ 'jig rten gyishekhams de dag gi mtha' dang / mu gzungaltebar nus sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das desami nus so/ / bde bar gshegs pa de mi nus so/ /⑤bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhedashen 'jig rten gyi khams de thams cad 'od kyis khyab par mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na ji tsam 'odasnyitu btags pa gdags pas ⑨btags pa de thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi mdun 7na brgya'i char yang nye b.ratshwa)mi 'gro balgenas/ rgyu'itshwanyebar du yang mi bzod de8/de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam pa'i pha7rol tu phyin pa'otunye/ /yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od la ni rtsig hunyepa'am/ shing ngam/ljon pa'am/ khor yug gi ri 'amatsho/ khor yug chen po 'am/ ri spos kyi ngad ldang ngas 3 / ri btang bzung ngayo te/ ri btang bzung chen po 'am/ gangs ri 'am/ ri gnya' shing 'dzin tam/ de ma yin padza shegazhan ri nag po 'am/ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang ⑫/ gang gis kyang sgrib (stepar mi nus te/ de dag thams cad las thal nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di khyab par byas kyang dman pa tsol mos pa'i sems can rnams mos par (nyemi 'gyur te/ de la sems can la las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od 'dom ganga' 7tsam du mthong ngo / /gangake de bas rgya che ba de dag gisalge ni 'od 'dom do tsam du mthong ngo / /gang tede bas shin tu rgya che ba de dag gis ni 'od 0rgyang grags 41—7

tsam 1du mthong ba nas gang de bas kyang shin tu rgya chen pos niphu'od stong gsum gyi stong chen po tsam gyi bar du mthong ste/ de ltar na7shā ri'i bu stong phrag brgya pa'i 5tshangs pas ni snyo'ajig rten gyi khams stong phrag brgya'i bar dushe'od kyis khyab par namathong ste she)rgyas par bya'o/ /sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpas ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa'i bar du khyab par 12mthong ngo / /de ltar shā ri'i bu nam mkha'i khams ji5)tsam parnyusems can gyi khams kyang de tsam ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can la thugs brtse ba'i phyir de 7tsam du 17'od kyis khyab par mdzad 3)do/ /de byang chub sems dpas thos 18nas the tshom med/ som nyi mi za3)/ mngon par dad/ yid ches/rab tu rtog / rgya cher du )dga' mgu ste(1/ rangs pa rnyed nas ngo mtshar dang rmad du 'du shes skyed do/ / 'di la du nyechos nyid ni sgo 'di yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /nurwanyi ma zla ba'i 'od gang dang (ge/ /brgya byin tshangs 'od gang yod dang zhe/ /'og min bar gyi 'od rnams kyis/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do / /'og min gyi ni 'od rnams dang / /gang rnams stong gsum khyab gyur pas//sangs rgyas spu'i byu ne'od zer gyi rte/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /nam mkha' dag ni ji 9tsam par ri/ /de tsam 'od kyis khyab byed pa/ /blo gros rgya chen sems can gyis / /de 'dra bar ni 'od semathong ngo / /sangs rgyasatshwanye'odamanyeni mtha' yas te/ /nam mkha' dag0geni mtshungs mnyam pa 49/ /ji ltar 'dul bar 'gyur rnams kyis/ /de 'dra bar ni 'odamu tshomathong ngo / /ji ltar skyes bu dmus long gis/ /nyi ma'i 'od ni de 'dra bar (snye/ /ma mthong bas ni rte'od de la / /'odang ni yod pa min zhes sa / /de bzhin sems can dman༄rtepa gang / /41wa 8

rgyal ba'i 'od ni mi mthong ste/ /ma mthong bas naturgyal ba yi/ /'odasho ni yod du )pa min zhes zer/ /la las ④'dom do tsam du mthongasnyi/ /la las rgyang grags dpag tshad dang / /la las stong gsum thams cad du/ /'od kyis khyab par gyur parnyumathong / /sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa medang / /bcu pa la ni gang gnas pal / /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab che/ /sa chen la ni gang gnas pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od/ /mtha' yas dkyil 'khor 'jug byed ⑨cing ske/ /bsam yas sangs rgyas zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas dag gi bya ba byed//de ltar sangs rgyas bsam yas te⑩/ /sangs rgyas 'od zeratshwanyebasam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas na(nye/ /bsod nams phung po bsam mi khyab/ /yangarwarteshā ri'i bu ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /the tshom mi za/ rgya cherachadaga' mgu stenya/ rangs pa rnyed nas ngo mtshar dang /rmad du ⑩'du shes skyed pa dang rdzo 7/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches/rab tu rtog pa nas ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi bar du 'du shes skyed ce na/ 1nyeshā ri'i bu 'di ltar yiyang dag par 0smra bas smra ba dumatshul khrims yongs su dag pa'i sems can5 nye'ajig rten du byung ste/ lus kyi las yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa/ngag gi las yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyi las yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa 'jig rten du byung zhing skyes nas 'jig rten gyi chos kyis ma (nyegos pa/bram ze sdig pa spangs pa/ dge sbyong zhi ba/ bsam gtan pa'i mchog /ting nge༄ste'adzin dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa'i zhunyesems can 'jig rten du byung ba de ni〈 ste41—9

de bzhin gshegs pa yin par77yang dag par smra bas smra'o②/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / shā ri'i bu lhar bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / tshangs parashebacas pa dang /bdud dang 4ribacas pa dang / dge sbyong du bcas pasnyedang / bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu 6)dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ji ltar mede bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ltar tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po yongs su dag pa/tshad med pa de lta bu ngas ma mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa nishetshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa'o⑨/ /shā ri'i bu khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa'i dpe tsam nyan ⑩par 'dod dam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar dge slong dag la ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te⑩/dpe tsam bshad na hunyebacom ldan 'das las ji ltar7thos pa7de bzhin du 'dzin par 'gyur te / bcom ldan 'das de'i dus ni 'di lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de'i dus ni 'di lags so/ tā 〉bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu de ji snyam du sems/ sems can gyi khams dang sa'i khams gang mang /de/ gsol pa/ ji ltar hu)bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal ba ltar na bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi khams ni rab tu mang gi sa'i khams ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin no/ /shā ri'i bu de de bzhin tezhu / shā ri'i bu sems can gyi khams rab tu mang gi sa'i khams ni ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bu gronyestong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 41—10

sems can ji snyed7sgo nga las skyes pa 'am/ mngal nas7skyes pa 'am/ drod gsher las skyes pa 'am/ rdzus ②te skyes pa 'am/ gzugs can nam/gzugs med pa 'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa 'am/ 'du shes med ④'du shes med min gyi sems can rnams ji tsam du phyesems can du gdags pas btags pa de7thams cad yongs su brtag pa bzung stetsho/ skad cig thang cig7yud tsam cigashegis snga phyi med par mi yi7lus5)thob par gyur layi/ shā ri'i bu mir gyur pa'i sems can de dgatsothams cad skad cig thang ciganyeyud tsam ciganyegis snga phyi med par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cing7yongs su brtag pa5nyebazung stonye/ de bzhin gshegs pa re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ji snyed pa7de snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par sprul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re la yang dbu stong stong du gyur(7/ dbu re re la yang zhal stong stong du gyur/ zhal re re la yang ljags stong stong du gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad stobs bcu dang ldan par gyur/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / chags pa med pa sgrib pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa dang ldan par gyur la/ shā ri'i bu de lta bu'i de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lasake brtsams te/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du bsngags pa brjod kyang〈 stede bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po ni de 'dra sto nye/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po yang mi zad(nye/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi shes rab dang / spobs padza )bla na med pa yang mi zadamanyede/41—11

de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad de'i bar du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi shes rab dang /spobs pa bla na med pa dang de gnyis ni tshad med grangs medanyu/ bsam gyis mi khyabani / nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing mtshungs so / /shā ri'i bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can lta zhog la/ shā ri'i bu shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i ribaklung gi bye ma snyed na sems can ji snyed pa dang / de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs dang / de bzhin du phyogs mtshams7dang / phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang nagā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig 7yud tsam cig ribagis mi'i lus ④thob par gyur pa〈nye nas/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa'i nyunyebar du gong ma bzhin du rgyas par bya hurteste/ 'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi shes rab dang / spobs pa bla na med pa dang / de gnyis tshad med grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing mtshungs te⑩/de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni hustetshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i〈nyedam pa'i pha rol tu son pa'o8/ /shā ri'i bu khyod de bzhin gshegs〈nyepa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpe tsam du bya ba nyan 4)par 'dod dam/gsol pa/ 'di ltar dge slong rnams bcom ldan 'das las thos nas de bzhin du 'dzin par 'gyur te//9 bcom ldan 'das de'i dus 'di lags so/ /41—12

bde bar gshegs pa de'i tshod ①'di lags so/ /②bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu de'i dus de'i tshod 'byung stenya/ nyi ma bdun 'jig rten du byung bar gyur nas ⑤stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'bar/ kun tu sti'abar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing ⑦'bar tedu/'bar ba gcig tu gyur par ⑨'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'bar ba gcig tu gyur pa de'i sa 7phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gamatshoske/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs sam/ mnal ba'itshwanyes phyogs de ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos bcu7dang ldan par 'gyur rotshi/ /bcu gang zhe na/ sa phyogs de lag mthil ltar mnyam par 'gyur te/ sa phyogs de7ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos dang po 'di dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 7shā ri'i bu ⑩'jig rten gyi khams 'bar/ kun tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing tunye'abar tetunye/'bar ba gcig tu gyur pa der sa phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gams ske/ bzhengs sam/ bzhu/gas sam/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs de gseg ma dang ske/ gyo mo med cing mtho bar gyur pa'i gzugs sumanya'agyur te/ sa phyogs de (1ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos gnyis pa 'di dang ldan par 'gyur mobe/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'bar/ kun tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing〈 ste'abar tedu ge/ 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas 'tshig pa derar+sās phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gamasasme/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs samal/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs de de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su longs spyod pa'i〈 byephyir yangs shing mnyam par 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de5nyengo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos gsum po'age'adi dang ldan par 'gyur ro rte/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 41—13

'jig rten gyi khams 'bar/ kun tu 'bar/ ①kun tu rab tu mched cing ②'bar te / 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas 'tshig pa derakyis phyogs gang nasade bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gamatsho/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs sam/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs der rtswa sdomachab/ 'khyil pa/ 'jam pa/ g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pa/ka tsa lin di ka ②ltar reg na bde stib/ dri rab tu zhim pa skye bar 'gyur te/shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de ⑩ ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos bzhi pa 'di dang ldan par 'gyur ro/sto/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams7'bar/ kun tu 'bar / kun tu rab tu mched cing〈nye'abar te④/ 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas 'tshig pa der mas phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gam/ bzhengasalgesam / bzhugs sam/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs der yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu grang ba/ yang ba/ 'jam pa/ dang ba⑩/ rtog pa med pa/ rab tu dang〈nyeb/ 'thung 'dod pa/ mang du 'thungs kyang nad du mi 'gyur ba yan lag 'di〈 ze brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de shu)ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos lnga pa 'di dngaku ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'bar/ kun tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing tso'abar te'u/ 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas 'tshig pa der dus phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gamanya/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs sam/mnal ba'i sa phyogs der/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas (nyerab tu bsil ba'i rlung ldang ba du )de 'di lta ste dper na/ shā ri'i bu sos ma'i tha ma'i zla ba 3)tshangaX bas gdungs5)pa'i dus na/ skyes bu la la zhig gang gā'i klung du zhugs nas/ lus bsil bar byas te/ rims dang snyom pa thams 41wa 14

cad zhi bar byas nas gang gā'i klung nas ①byung zhing slar byung nas 'chag cing 'gro ba las ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na nagasakhustug po yal ga dang / lo ma dang ske/ 'dab ma grib ma stug po dang ldan pa7zhig mthong nas de nags stug⑧po gang na yod pa0der song ste phyin pa dang / nags stug po'i dbus na khri'i steng du phyar bu bting7ba/ be'u ras kyis g.yogs pal/ ka tsa lin di ku'i7gding ba bting7 snab/ de'i steng dar gyis g.yogs pa/ ya tog ma tog77tu sngas dmar po ⑩bshams pa zhig mthong nas de de la 'dug go/ /de de la tunye'adug ste 'greng7zhing phyogs bzhi7kun nas bsil ba'i rlung ldang bar7'gyur ba de bzhin du/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs der bsil ba'i rlung ldang bar 'gyur te/shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de (nyengo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos drug pa 'di dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ zhagazhan yang shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'bar/ kun tu 'bar / kun tu rab tu mched cing tunye'abar te( )/ 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas 'tshig pa deralos phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gam22/ bzhengs sam / bzhugs sam/ mnal buba'i sa phyogs der chu las skyes pa'i (steme tog ud pa la0 dang / pad ma stodang / ku mu da (rtedang / pad ma dkar po 3nyeskye bar 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de nu)ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos bdun pa (ste 'di dang ldan par 'gyur ronyu/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'bar kun tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing 'bar tes / 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas/ 'tshig (nyepa der nunyes phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gamatsho/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs sam/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs der thang las skyes pa'i nyeme tog 'di lta ste/ a timu stamug ta ka dang / tsam pa ka dang /41—15

sna ma'i me togs3)dang / ba ri sha kukhudang / mya ngan 'tshangashedang / skya snar dang / dong ku'i me togasredang / ta ra ni dang / go ta ra ni la sogasakyipa thang las skyes pa'i〈me tog sna tshogs7kha dog dang ldan pa/ dri dang ldan pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de 0ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos brgyad pa 'di dang ldan par 'gyur ro) / /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'bar/ kun tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing (7'bar te⑩/'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas 'tshig pa der 8sa phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa 'chag gams/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs sam/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs de sra zhingamo mi shigs pa/ sa gzhi rdo rjer 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de ni ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi chos dgu pa 'di dang ldan par 'gyur rmanye/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lam me/ rab tu (2lam me/ kun tu rab tu༄) lam me/ 'bar tekun tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing 'bar te/ 'bar ba gcig tu gyur nas/ 'tshig dupa der 3sa phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'chag gamyosasnye/ bzhengs sam/ bzhugs sam/ mnal ba'i sa phyogs de lhar zhugebacas pa'i 'jig rten dang / bdud du (stobacas pa dang tshangs par bcas pa dang (rte/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu5nyedang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten du 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de ngo mtshar dang / rmad kyi chos bcu po 'di dang ldan par 'gyur te/zhu) shā ri'i bu sa phyogs de ni ngo mtshar dang / rmad kyi chos bcu po de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ronyu/ /yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 41wa 16

dbyings7shin tu rtogs te⑤/ de rtogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji ltar mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems la gcig tu bde bar so sor7yang dag par myong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bzhugs kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su 'bri ba med paradza pengs bshad do/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa bsod snyoms gcig gis bskal par gnas sam/ bskal pa brgya 'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ bskal pa stong phrag brgya 'amanya/ bskal pa bye ba 'am/ bskal pa bye ba brgya 'am/ bskal pa bye ba stong ngam/ bskal pa bye ba stongashephyag brgya 'amatsho/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgyalostong ngam/ de las lhag par yang bzhugs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog gi dam pa'i pha rol tu son nyu pa ste/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul r+ṣa/ de ltar mthu ches/ de ltar dbang che bar grags pa'o⑩/ /'di lta ⑩ste/ dper na shā ri'i bu 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi lha'i nang du lha'i burwanyeskyes pa de〈pedamigs pa gcig la gnas pa'i rnam par shes pas bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'dug ste/bsam gtan gyis che'i mtha' 'chi ba'isri dus ma byas kyi bar du rnam par shes pa de las rnam par shes pa gzhan tedu mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du shā ri'i bu gang gi nub mo de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / gang gi nub mo phung po'i0 lhag ma med〈 stepa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i〈 nyedabyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa 41—17

de'i bar du de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin las nyams pa med/ sems 'gyur ba ༅med/ sems rgyu brtsolamed/ sems rnam par rgyu ba med/ sems rab tu rgyu ba med/ sems rgyas pa med/ sems kyi 'dren pa med/ sems g.yeng ba med/ sems mtho snob med/ sems dma' ba med/④ sems kun tu srung chogeb med/ sems sbed pa ⑥med/ sems tshim pa med/ sems mi 'thunang pa med/ sems 'dud pa5nyemed/ sems g.yo ba med/ sems rab tu dga' bar byed pa med/ sems zhum pa med/ sems rtog pa med/sems rnam par rtog pa medasti/ sems yongs su rtog pa med/ sems kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rnam par shes pa med/ sems mig la gnas pa med/ rna ba dang ske/ sna 17dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid la gnas pa med/ semasarwagegazugs la gnas pa med/ sems sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang ske/ chos la gnas pa med/ sems chos la 'jug pa med/ sems rnam par shes pa la 'jug pa med/ sems 'das pa la yang mi lta3nye/ sems ma 'ongs pa la yang mi lta/ sems da ltar byung ba la yang mi lta ste/ de ltar na 8'a ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas/ sems las 8chos gang yang btsal 8ba med mod kyi / lhun gyis nyu mogrub pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba 18'jug go/ /'di ltar nyusheshā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa dang bral (3 mod kyi gnas kyang mi 'dor te/ lhun gyis grub 21pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad kyang mdzad zhu do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal (nyate/41—18

bde bar gshegs pas7de skad gsungs nas/ ston pakhuyang 'di skad gsung ngoshe/ /bskal pa brgya stong dpag tu7med cing gzhal yas par/ /sngon gyi srid pa'i 'gro bar byang chub spyod spyad tshe/ /tshul khrims dang ni thos dang ting 'dzin bag yod dang / /bzod pa dag kyang byang chub mchog phyir 'dren pasaralpibasgomasadu / /rgyal ba'i rtogs dang7'bras bu dge ba 'di 'dra bas/ /tshul khrims shin tu yongs dag 'jig rten kun gyi mchog /ji ltar nam mkha' dri med rnam paratshwanyespros med5nyeltar/ /stobs bcu'i〈nyetsal khrims dri mtshwanyemed patshamanam mkha' bzhin/ /gang gi 7nub mo rgyal bas dang po byang chub rtogs/ /gang gi nub mo tha mar mya ngan 'das gshegs tsherte/ /stobs bcu rnams las(shesems rgyu rab tu rgyu ba med/ /de bzhin bsam gtan ting 'dzin nyams pa nam yang〈nye med/ /stobs bcu rnams kyi tshul khrims phung po nyams med de(1/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang rnam thar nyams pa'i char 'gyur med(rte/ /bskal pa brgya phrag stong du sems ni gcig gis〈 steganas/ /'dren pa la ni rtog dang rnam par rtog pa7med/ /'dren pa rnams kyi durnam rtog spyod yul nam mkha' 'dra( nye/ /dus gsum dag la sangs rgyas ye shes thogs (nyemed 'jug /stobs bcu rnams la sems yid rnam par rgyu ba dang / /rtog dang stong57pa med par sangs rgyas sras rnams dang / /de ltar shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /som nyi med / the tshom mi za/ rgya cheraspo spradaga' mgu sto1/ rangs pa rnyed nas ngo mtshar dang / rmad du ge'adu shes skyed do/ /shā ri'i bu ji ltar na byang chub 41—19

sems dpa' 1 de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyisade bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtogadu /som nyi med/ the tshom mi za/ rgya cherasredaga' mgu stenya/ rangs pa rnyed nas/ngo mtshar dang rmad du du'adu shes skyed ce na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'di skad du gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di ni nga'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che ba'i nang na mchog go zhes gsungs te⑦/ byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul de la 'jal zhing yongs su dpyodani/ byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul la yang7'jal zhing yongs su dpyod do/ /gzhal te yongs su dpyad nas ⑩byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul dang mtshungs shing (nyamanyam par ma ⑩mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul la 'jal la5nyegazhal cing yongs su dpyad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul la 'jal zhing yongs su dpyod dos/ /gzhal7te yongs su dpyad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang mtshungs shing mnyam par ma mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul nitshwanyebasam gyis mi khyab bo snyam nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul yongs su grub par bya ba'i phyir rgya cher brtson 'grus rtsom motsho/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul las brtsams te dpe tsam du bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa las khyod nyan zhu par 'dod dam/ (7bcom ldan 'das de'i dus 'di lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de'i tshodasnyilags so/ / 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis rdustedage slong rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul las brtsams te dpe 25bshad na rte/ dge slong rnamasamanyebacom ldan 'das las de 41—20

thos nas de bzhin du 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir shā ri'i bu7legs par rab tu7nyon la7yid la zung shig dang bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin no zhes gsol nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar 0nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu de ji snyam du sems/ gnas brtan mod gal gyi dushechen po rdzu 'phrul che bsheyin nam gsol pa/ dge slong nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che ba'ishenang na 'di ltar gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu7chen po 'di ni〈nyamachog go zhes bdag gis bcom ldan 'das las5)mngon sum du thos te mngon sum dutsobazung0ngo / /bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po mod gal gyi bu lta bus 'di lta ste dper na⑩/ bu ram shing stug po 'am5)'dam bu stug po 'amanya/ 'od ma stug po 'a47/ til gyi zhing ngam/ 'bras kyi0zhing bzhin dusngo tegang bar gyur la/ de ltar gcig tu 'dus pa'i〈 )nyan thos kyi tshogs de lta busalgemathu dang brtson 'grus thams cad dang rduste/ rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyi stobs thams cad bstan kyang (stede bzhin gshegs pa'i cho (nya'aphrul gyi brgya'i char yang nye bar nyemi 'gonye/ stong gi char yang (rte/ brgya stong gi char yangakyi /bye ba'i char yang te/ bye ba brgya'i char yang rte/ bye ba stong gi char yang / bye ba brgya stong gi char yang / grangs su yang / char yang / bgrang bar yang /dper yang / rgyur yang nye bar mi 'gro'o(nye/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son stepa'o/ /shā ri'i bu gal te 41—21

de bzhin gshegs pas sa 'di la yungs kuramanyugyi 'bru gcig⑧bzhag na / de bzhin gshegs pas yungs kur gyi ④'bru bzhag pa de yang de ⑤lta bu'i nyan thos kyi tshogs kyi nemathu dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / drag ④shul thams cad dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyi stobs thams cad bstan kyangasnyide bzhin gshegs pas bzhag pa'i yungs kur7gyi 'bru skra'i rtse mo gcig tsam yang bskyod par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rdzu 'phrul gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyu1dam pa'i pha rol tu sonatshwa pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di lta zhog la/ shā ri'i bu (nyeshar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na sems can ji snyed yod (stepa dang /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang / steng dngahū/phyogs mtshams tshadang / hunyephyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na sems can jisatsam sgo nga las skyes pa 'am/ mngal nas skyes pa nas 39'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi bar gyi sems can de dag thams cad yongs su brtag pa bzung〈kye ste/ nyan thos5nyerdzu 'phrul chen po 'di lta ste dper na/ mod gal gyi bu chen po lta bur gyur la(rte/ shā ri'i bu de lta bu'i〈nyenyan thos kyi tshogs ni:thams cad kyis (nyestobs dang / mthu dang / drag shul thams cad dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyi stobs thams cad bstan kyang〈 stoyungs du tsho'abru yang gdeg par mi nus te rte/ tha na skra'i rtse mo'i cha (7tsam yang bskyod par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni rdzu 'phrul gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i0bye dam pa'i pha rol tu son57pa ste/ shā ri'i bu 41—22

de bzhin gshegs pa ni ①de ltar rdzu 'phrul che/ de ltar mthu che/ de ltar dbang che bar grags pa'o②/ /de nas yang rtsibacom ldan 'das kyis ④tshi dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod kyis nam 'jig pa'i bskal pa'i dus kyi tsher gyur pa de na kun ⑤tu 'jom 57pa zhes bya'i ⑩rlung ldang stekhya/rlung de langs pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yi ⑨ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / huX )khor yug gi rirwaskyedang / tunyekhor yug gi ri〈nyechen po dang / gling chen po bzhi dang / gling brgyad khri dang / ri chen po dang /rgya mtsho chen po yang dpag tshad srid du mngon par 'phen cing rab tu 'thor bar 'gyur ba khyod kyis7thos sam/ gsol pa/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das las mngon sum du thos te mngon sum dutsobazung ngo / /bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu nam 'jig pa'i ()rlung 'byung ba de ni kun hunyetu 'jom 1)pa chen po zhes bya'i (3 rlung ldang ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di ri rab dang bcas/ khor yug dang bcas/ ri dang bcas/ rgya mtsho dang bcas(nyu/dpag tshad brgyar mngon par 'phen cing sarab tu 'thor/ dpag tshad nyis brgya dang / dpag tshad sum brgya dang / dpag tshad bzhi brgya ( nyedang /dpag tshad lnga brgya〈 stedang / dpag tshad stong dang / dpag tshad nyis stong dang /sum stong dang / bzhi stong dang / lnga stong du mngon par 'phen cing5nyerab tu 'thor / dpag tshad brgyar+sā9phrag mang po dang / dpag tshad stong phrag mang po dang /nye dpag tshad brgyas2)stong phrag mang por mngon par 'phen cingamakhyerab tu 'thor te/ de dag gi rdul yang mi snang na ri dang rdo rnams lta ci smos/ 'thab bral gyi nunye lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang rnams kyang dkrugs bcom/ rab tu 41—23

gtor te/ de dag gi rdul yang mi snang na gzhal med khang rnams lta ci smos/dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi 1)bdud kyi ris rnams dang / tshangs pa rnams dang 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang gi bar du de bzhin du rgyas par bya'o/ /ji ltar 'thab bral gyishedakrugs bcomasarab tu gtor te0/dkrugs bcom rab ⑤tu gtor ba de dag gi rdul yang ⑥mi snang na gzhal med khang dang ra ba rnams lta ci smos/ shā ri'i bu gal te de lta bu'i rlung langs kyang des de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos gos kyi mtha' ma'i rtse mo tsam yang g.yos par mi nus na/ chos gos sam/ chos gos kyi grwa lta nici smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod lam dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lam dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snying rje chen poshedang ldan no/ /shā ri'i bu gal te 'di lta bu'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor shar phyogs dang ske/ lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang / steng dang /phyogs mtshams hu byedang / phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 3 cidu rlung mngon par ldang yang / shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig par byed pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor de de bzhin gshegs pa'i sor mo'i rtse mos zlog /gekyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyi stobs bri ba yang med do8/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab stekho/ de la byang chub sems dpa' mngon par dad/ yid chesatso/ som nyi med/ the tshom mi za/41—24

rgya cheratudaga' mgu gho/ rangs pa rnyed nas ngo mtshar dang / rmad du 'du shes skyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'dishenyid rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs soX/ /khams gsum sems can ji snyed paX/ / gnas brtan mod gal bu bzhin duX/ /rdzu 'phrul pha rol phyin pa yi/ /nyan thos mkhas par kun gyur pasag/ /rdzu 'phrul thams cad rab bstanasakyang / /de bzhin gshegs pas sa 'di la/ /yungs kur gyi ni 'bru gzhag pa/ / g.yo bar bya bar mi nus so/ /⑨gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams/ /gang gā yi ni bye ma snyedayi/ / rnam 'thor rlung dang kun 'joms pa(nye/ /rlung rnams7phyogs bcur langs par gyur8/ /de lta bu yi7rlung chen des/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i chos gos kyi/ /mtha' ma skra yi rtse tsam yang / /g.yo bar bya bar mi nus tho sna/ /thub pa chen po'i spu gcig gis/ /rlung de5nyerab tu zlog par mdzad()/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'di 'dra ba/ /mtha' yas pa ni0 nam mkha' bzhin/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches pa nas ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi bar du 'du shes skyed do/ /yang shā ri'i bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /som nyi med/ the tshom mi za/ rgya cher dga' mgu stonye/ rangs pa rnyed nas/ ngo mtshar dang rmad du〈 nye'adu shes skyed ce na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ni bcu po 'di dag ste/ stobs de dag dang ldan pas de 41—25

bzhin gshegs pa khyu mchog gi gnas su dam 'cha' zhing dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am / lha 'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs ①pa 'am/ sus kyang 'jig rten 'dir chos dang 'thun par ma bskor ba'i tshangs pa'i 'khor lo rab tushebaskor to la/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen⑧pa'i stobs dang / las dang gyirnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mos pa du ma dang / mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / khams du ma dang /khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi rim pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / thams cad du tso'agro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i snikun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / ldang ba mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mngon sum du byed pa 1)mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / 'chi yi 'pho tunyedang / skye ba mngon sum 12du byed pa /tsho mkhyen pa'i stobs midang / zag pa zad pa 8mngon sum du byed pa tsomakhyen pa'i stobs so/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu po de dag ste/ stobs de dag dang ldan pas hunyede bzhin gshegs pa 'khor gyi nang du yang dag par seng ge'i sgra sgrog cing pho khyu mchog gi gnas su zhal gyi 'che 37ba nas/ sus kyang 'jig rten du niX chos dang 'thun par ma bskor ba tshangs pa'i 'khor lo rab tu skor (1ba'i bar du'o/ / de la (nyede bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas dang / gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs gang zhe na/'di la sa shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i〈 sīye shes kyi stobs kyis gnas kyang gnas sung ge/ gnas ma yin pa'angarwastoganas ma 47—26

yin par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to①/ /de la gnas gang /gnas ma yin pa gang zhe na/ shā ri'i bu gang lus kyis nyes ②par spyod ②pa'i rnam par smin pa 'dod pa dang / sdug pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong ba mngon par 'grub pa dephuni gnas ma yin te/ skabs med do/ /gang lus kyis nyes par spyadasnyipa dang / ngag gis nyes par spyadarnyupa dang / yid kyis nyes par spyad7pa'i rnam par smin pa mi du'adod pa dang / mi sdug pa dang /mi dga' ba dang / yid du mi 'ong ba mngon par 'grub pa de ni gnas yin7te skabs yod do/ /gang lus kyis legs par spyad (ste pa dang / ngag gis〈nyelegs par spyad ⑩pa dang / yid kyis legs par spyad hunyepa'i rnam par smin pa mi 'dod pa dang / mi sdug pa dang / mi dga' ba dang / yid du mi 'ong ba mngon par 'grub pa de ni gnas ma yin te skabs med do/ /gang lus kyis legs par spyad7pa dang / ngag gis legs par spyad7pa dang / yid kyis legs par spyad7pa'i rnam par smin pa/ 'dod pa dang / sdug pa dang /dga' ba dang / yid du ṇa/nye'ong ba mngon par 'grub pa de ni gnas yin (nyete skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang ser snas longs spyod chen po mngon par 'grub pa de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang ser snas dbul por 'gyur ba de ni gnas yin te/ skabs hu)yod do/ ༷༷ 'di ni gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de2nye/ gang sbyin pas dbul por 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang sbyin pas longs spyod chen po mngon par 'grub pa de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang 'chal ba'i〈2tshul khrims kyis ni lha dang mir skye ba rnyed pa de ni 41—27

gnas ma yin no/ /gang 'chal ba'ishetshul khrims kyis7sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ dud 'gro'i7skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba de ni gnas yin te/ skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni gnas ma yin zhing skabs med debya/ gang tshul khrims kyis sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i7skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang tshul khrims kyis lha dang mir skye ba thob pa de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang duganod ⑦sems kyis ⑧gzugs mdzes pa mngon par 'grub pa de7ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang gnod sems kyis gzugs mi sdug pa mngon par 'grub pa de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang bzod pas gzugs mi sdug pa mngon par 'grubalgepa de ni gnas ma yin no0/ /gang bzod pas gzugs mdzes pa mngon par 'grubatshwanyepa de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang le los 'thob pa dang /mngon par rtogs par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang le los 'thob pa dang ske/ mngon par rtogs par mi 'gyur ba de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang brtson 'grus kyis 'thob pa dang ske/ sgomangon par rtogs par mi 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin noyi/ /gang ⑫brtson 'grus kyis 'thob pa dang /77 mngon par rtogs par〈nye'agyur ba de7ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/gang sems g.yengs〈sna pas nges par gyur pa (skyel 'jug par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang sems g.yengs nu pas nges par gyur pa〈 nyel mi 'jug pa de ni 41—28

gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /yang shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing7skabs med de / gang ma byin par len pa spangs pa'i skyes bu gang zag dbul por 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang ma byin par len pa spangs pa'i skyes bu gang zag longs spyod chen por 'gyur ba de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang 'dod pa lasalog par g.yem pa'i skyes bu gang zag chung ma 'gran zla medas④pa rnyed pa de ni gnas ma yin no/ /yang shā ri'i bu gang 'dod pa la rgyalog par g.yem7pa'i skyes bu gang zag chung ma 'gran zla yod pa 35rnyed pa de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing skabs med de/ gang 'dod pa laphulog par g.yem pa spangs pa'i skyes bu gang zag chung ma 'gran zla dang bcas pa ⑨rnyed pa de ni gnas ma yin no/ /yang nyu )shā ri'i bu 'dod pa la 3tshelog par g.yem pa spangs pa'i skyes bu gang zag chung ma 'gran zla med 8pa rnyed pa de ni gnas yin te skabs yod do/ / gong matsobazhin du sbyar te/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi lam gsum po de dag ⑫bstan pa de bzhin du mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam thams cad la'ang bya'o/ /gang brdzun du 8ma ba des skur pa thob par mi 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang thob par 'gyur ba de ni gnas so/ /gang brdzun ⑩du ⑩smra ba spangs pas skur pa thob par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang thob par mi 'gyur ba de ni gnas so(༷ / /gang phra ma zer bas mi phyed pa'i g.yog rnyed pa de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang rnyed par mi 'gyur ba de ni gnas so/ /gang phra ma spangs pa'i du nyagayog phyed nu par 'gyur ba de 3 ni gnas ma yin no/ /gang g.yog mi phyed pa rnyed pa zhu༄de ni gnas so/ /gang tshig༄nyertsub po 2nyesmra bas rtag par yid 41—30

ba bzhin 1rab tu mkhyen to/ /mos pa gang gis rnam par grol ba thob par ②'gyur ba de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinasherab tu mkhyen to/ /mkhyen nas kyang de5gebazhin du chos ston to/ /de ltar na shā ri'i busade bzhin gshegs pa'i7mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs gang yin pa de ni mtha' yas mu med de/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing mnyam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 3)de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑨yos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs de thos nas mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /som nyi med/ the tshom mi za/ rgya cher 7dga' mgu stonye/ rangs pa rnyed nas nam mkha' lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 8phyir ngo mtshar dang rmad 'du 'du shes skyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid rgya cherachabastan pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /'jig rten 'di mos sna tshogs dang / / de bzhin blo gros tshad med pa'i/ /de dag gi ni mos pa'i sems thams cad 'dren pas rab tu mkhyen/ /gang dag 'dod chags mos pa 'kho/ /zhe snang la ni hu snaganas 'gyurarwanidang / /zhe snang gnas shing gti mug la/ /gang dag mos parwarterab tu mkhyen/ /gti mug gnas shing 'dod chags kyi/ /sems rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab padu ༷ / /bar bar du ni 'jug pa dag(nye /de dag 'dren pas rab tu mkhyen/ /gang dag tri sbyor ba dman 'gyur shu la/ /rgya chen la ni mos pa dang ske/ /sbyor ba dam pa de dag gi/ / dman par 'gyur ba 'dren pas tsomakhyen / /log pa'i rjes su song ba dang / /'gro ba med par byung bsnyi dang / /khams gsum las 39ni rnam grol ba'i/ /mos pa dag kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /skye dang kha dog tha dad dang / /nye bar spyod pa'i khyad par dang / /gang dag spyi bo 41wa 42

las nyams pa①/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos rab tu mkhyen/ /mos pa sna tshogs rab mkhyen nas/ /'dren pa chos rnams ston pa mdzadage/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni stobs snyugasum la/ /rgyal ba'i thugs srasaphurab tu mos/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs gsum pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyu mchog gi gnas su zhal gyis 'che nizhing 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra yang dag par sgrog ste/ dge sbyongashengam/ bram ze 'am/ lha 'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'amatshu/ sus kyang 'jig rten du chos dang 'thun par ma bskor brwanyetshangs pa'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor to8/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas khams du ma dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis 'jig rten rnams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin (nyerab tu mkhyen to/ /khams gang gis 'jig rtenas8bsod nams kyi 'du byed7sogs pa de yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinatsorab tu mkhyen to/ /khams gang gis bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'du byed hu)sogs zhu pa de yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin (nyarab tu mkhyen to/ /khams gang gis mi g.yo ba'i 'du byed sogs du nyepa de yang de bzhin gshegasarmānyepas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin durab tu mkhyen to/ /khams gang gis 'byung ba'i khams su 'jog par 'gyur ba de yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin༄9rab tu mkhyen to/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas mig gi khams dang ske/ gzugs kyi khams dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang rab tu mkhyen to/ /ji ltar rab tu mkhyen ce na/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong 41—43

pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dusherab tu mkhyen to/ /yid kyi khams dang / chos kyi khams dang /ge yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yangasherab tu mkhyen to kyi/ /ji ltar rab tu mkhyen ce na/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid duphurab tu mkhyen to/ /sa'i khams dang ske/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams rab tu mkhyen to / /ji ltar rab tu mkhyen ce na/ nam mkha'i khams ji lta ba de bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang /gzugs med pa'i khams rab tu mkhyen to/ /ji ltar rab tu mkhyen ce na/kun tu rtog pa las byung ribabar rab tu mkhyen to/ /'dus byas kyi khams nishemangon par 'du byed pa'i mtshan nyid du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'dus ma byas kyi khams ni mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i mtshan nyid du rab tu mkhyen to/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa'i khams ni phyis tso'abyung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid du rab tu mkhyen to/ /rnam par byang ba'i khams ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i mtshan nyid du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'du byed kyi khamasarwanyeni tshul bzhin ma yin pa ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid du rab tu mkhyen to/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings nyunyeni tshul bzhin rig pa'i mtshan nyid du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'disheltar 'jig rten gnas pa'i khams gang yin pa 8dang / 'jig rten gnas pa tsokhams gang 1 la gnas pa dang / khams gang la rjes su ()chags pa dang /khams gang la gnas pa dang / khams gang la sbyor ba dang / khams gang gi57bsam pa dang / khams gang la nges par sems pa dang / khams gang la rten5) pa de yang sa1de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du derab tu mkhyen to//41wa 44

mkhyen nas kyang chos ston to/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams du ma dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs mtha' yas mu med de nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing mnyam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i ②khams du ma dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs nil mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /som nyisremed/ the tshom mi za/ rgya cher dga' mgu steX/ rangs pa rnyed nas nam mkha' lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ngo mtshar dang / rmad du 'du shes skyed do/ / 'di la'uchos nyid ni 'di yin te/ deshel 'di skad ces bya'o/ /'jig rten kun na sems can gang / /snachatshogs khams la gnas pa dag / khams gang 'jug pa ci 'dra btso/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni rab tu mkhyen/ /bsod nams bsod nams min misagayo/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba'angatshwastede bzhin te/ /khams rnams gang la gnas nas su/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi la reg /mig gi khams dang gzugs kyi khams/ /mig gi rnam par shes7nyid dang / /rna ba sna dang lce dang lusatso/ /yid kyi khams kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /chos kyi khams dang yid kyi ni/ /rnam par shes pa nyid kyang mkhyen/ /nang gi khams ni stong pa dang / /phyi rol dag kyang stong par mkhyen/ /sa dang chu dang me dag dang / /rlung gi khams kyang de bzhin te / /khams rnams bzhi po de dag ni/ /nam mkha' mtshungs pararwa phorab tu mkhyen / /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs kyi khams/ /gzugs med pa yi khams nyid kyang / / kun tu hunyertog las byung bar 37ni/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rab tu mkhyen/ /ji ltar nam mkha'aphu )mtha' yas pa/ /de bzhin khams rnams mu med de⑥/ /thams cad sangs rgyas rab mkhyen kyang / /mkhyen to snyam du 41—45

gti mug yang ba ②skye ba de yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinakhurab tu mkhyen to/ /yongs su rtog pa'i dbang po ji lta bus snrel zhi'ikhu'adod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug skye ba de yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin0rab tu mkhyen to/ /yongs su rtogs0pa'i dbang po ji lta bus tshar bcad cing ⑥'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang /gti mug skye ba de yang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinakhurab tu mkhyen to/ / dbang po ⑧gang dag 0mi dge ba'i rgyu las byung ba dang ⑩/dbang po gang dganyedage ba'i rgyu las byung ba dang5)/ dbang po gang dag mi g.yo ba'i rgyu las byung ba dngahū/ dbang po gang dgakhe'abyung ba'i rgyu las byung ba 8de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin ⑩rab tu mkhyen to/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas mig gi dbang po yangatshwa snadag pa ji lta ba bzhinanyerab tu mkhyen pa nasazha gong ma01bzhin du sbyar te/rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi dbang po yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinas rab tu mkhyen to/ /lo'i dbang po dang / mo'i stedabang po dang / srog gi dbang po dang / bdes ba'i dbang po dang / sdug bsngal gyi dbang po dang / yid mi bde ba'i dbang po dang / yid bde ba'i dbang po dang / btang snyoms kyi dbang po yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen to/ /dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang /dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rabarkya tu mkhyen to zhu )/ /mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po dang / kun shes pa'i dbang po dang / kun 41—47

nges pa'i sems can gyi khams rkyen gyi stobs can yongs su smin par bya ba'i mtshan nyid can/ gal te 'thun par 'doms shing rjes su7ston pa dang phrad nasarnam par grol bar ('gyur gyi/ rjes su ston pa dang ma phrad na rnam par grol bar mi 'gyur ba de dag la yang de bzhin gshegs pa7de ltar rgyu dang rkyenashedang ldan pa'i gtam yang dag par gsungs te/ 'di ltarashede bzhin gshegs pa las chos de thos nas tshul bzhin rab tu sbyor bas 'bras bu thob par 'gyur teni/de dag gi don du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /log par nges pa'i sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyong bar7ma byas pa/ kho re chung ba blun pa snod du ma gyur pa'i sems can de dag la de bzhin gshegs pas chos bstan kyang rung / ma bstan kyang rung ste/ rnam par grol ba'i skal ba med pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas snod ma yin par rig nas btang snyoms su 'jog ste/ de dag gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams go5)gyon to/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas 'dod chags kyi lam rnam pa gsum rab tu mkhyen te/ 'dod chags kyi lam sdugatsosa'i rnam pa las 8skye ba yang yod/'dod chags kyi lam rjes su chags pa'i 8rnam pa las skye ba yang yod/ 'dod chags kyi lam sngon gyi rgyu las skye ba yang yod do/ /zhe sdang gi lam rnam pa gsum yang rab tu mkhyen te/ zhe sdang gi lam khong khro ba'i mtshan ma las skye ba yang yod/bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa las skye ba yang yod/ sngon gyi bag la nyal las skye ba yang yod do3 / /gti mug gi lam rnam pa gsum yang rab tu mkhyen te/gti mug gi lam ma rig pa'i rgyu las skye ba yang yod/ gti mug gi lam 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rgyu nyushelas skye ba yang yod/ gti mug gi lam the tshom gyi rgyu las 41—52

skye ba yang yod de0)/ de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinakhurab tu mkhyen to/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu dbang po rno ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa myur la sla ba'i lam /yang de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen to ca/ /dbang po rtul55)ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa bul la dka' ba'i lam 6)yang rab tu mkhyen to/ /dbang po rno ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa myur la sla ba'i lams7riyang rab tu mkhyen to/ /dbang po rtul ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa bul la sla ba'i lam7yang rab tu mkhyen to(skye/ / dmigs pa bor ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa bul la bul ba'i lam yang rab tu mkhyen tokyi ri/ /lam gyi rgyunamanyam bcad pa'i phyir mngon par shes pa myur la bul ba'i lam 12yang rab tu mkhyen to/snye/ /8yongs su thug pa med par dbugs 'byin pa'i phyir mngon par shes pa bul la myur ba'i lams8yang rab tu mkhyen to / /nyurtede la ma chags pa'i phyir mngon par shes pa myur la bul ba'i lam (/sreyang rab tu mkhyen to1tshe/ /so sor rtog pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par byed la sgom na )pa'i stobs la ma yin pa'i lam yang yod / sgomadza 1pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par byed la/ so sor rtog pa'i stobs la ma yin pa'i lam yang yod/ sgom ri pa'i stobs dang / so sor rtog pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i lam yang yod/ so sor rtog pa'i stobs dang / sgomatshan pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par mi byed pa'i lam yang yod de ri ) de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin 2nyerab tu mkhyen to/ /bsam pa phun sum tshogs la 3 sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa ma yin pa'i lam yang yod sbyor ba phun sum tshogs la bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa ma yin pa'i lam yang yod/ bsam pa yang 3 phun sum tshogs pa ma yin la sbyor ba'ang 41—53

mug ldan/ /rnam gsum rgya chen mtha' yas nyon mongs ldan/ /lam la0rkyen dang rgyu ni ston pas mkhyen/ / dka' ba'i lam la rno bar 'gyur7ba dang / /de bzhin dbang po rtul zhing7bul ba dang / /slababa'i lam la rtosnyibar 'gyur ba dang / /de bzhin bul ba'ang 'jig rten mgon pos mkhyen/ /bul ba'ishelam la sbyor ba bul ba yodani/ /de bzhin bul ba yin la sbyor ba rnol/ /myur ba'i lam la bul bar 'gyur ba dang / /de bzhin de la ma chags myur ba'ang yod/ /lam ni7so sor rtog pa skyed byed lonye/ /yang dag sgom pa skyed pa ma yin dang / / sgom pa dag ni skyed par byed pa dngahū/ / gnyi ga khyad par sbyor ldan skyed pa yod/ /lam ni bsam pa yongs su sbyong byed la/ /sbyor ba dag ni sbyong bar mi byed yod⑩/ / res 'ga' gnyi ga sbyong bar byed pa'anganyeyod⑩/ /de dag sangs rgyas thams cad gzigs pas mkhyen/ / lus la rnam par sbyong la ngag mi sbyong0/ /sems kyang rnam par sbyong〈 teb ma yin dang / /ngag rnams dang ni lus kyang rab sbyong la/ /sems ni res 'ga'5)mi sbyong ba yang yod/ /sems ni rab sbyong ngag la ma yin te/ /lus kyang rnam par sbyong ba ma yin dang / /ngag dang de bzhin sems kyang rab sbyong la/ / res 'ga'akhe lus ni sbyong bar mi 'gyur〈 nyeyod/ /lus dang de bzhin ngag sems sbyong lam dang / /ji ltar ldog dang 'jug par 'gyur ba rnams ⑩/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzigs pas rab mkhyen te/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs drug pa⑥ / /shā ri'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs drug pa ste/ stobs de dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa khyu mchog gi gnas su zhal gyis 'che57ba nas sus kyang 'jig rten du chos dang 'thun par5rtezhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de la de 41—55

bag la nyal7ni rgyu'o/ /kun nas ldang ba ni rkyen to②/ /sems can rnams kyi kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ba'i rgyu ni 'di rkyen ni 'di yin te7de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin⑧rab tu mkhyen to/ /de la sems can rnams kyi rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i rgyu gangasnyi/ rkyen gang zhe na/sems can rnams kyi rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i rgyu gnyis rkyen gnyis te/gzhan las rjes su 'thun pa'i sgra dang / so so bdag nyid tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ zhi gnas la rtse gcig pa dang / lhag mthong la mkhas pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu gnyis dang / rkyen gnyis te⑦/ 'gro ba med par shes pa dang / 'ong ba med par shes pa'o⑧/ /gzhan yang rgyu gnyis dang /rkyen gnyis te⑨/ skye ba med par rab tu rtogs 7pa dang / nges par gyur pa7tel mi reg pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu gnyis dang / rkyen gnyis te(she/ rkang par〈rteldan pachadang / rig pas7rnam par grol ba mngon sum du byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu gnyis dang / rkyen gnyis te/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo la sgomanyepa dang / rang bzhin gyis rnam par grol bar shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu gnyis dang ske/ rkyen gnyis te⑩/ zad pa 0shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu gnyis dang / rkyen gnyis te/ bden pa rjes su rtogs pa dang /bden pa rjes su thob pa'o⑩/ /rgyu de dang rkyen de dag ni sems can rnams rnam par dag par 'gyur ba ste/ de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa03 ji lta ba bzhin terab tu mkhyen to/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu sems can rnams kyi rtekun nas nyon mongs pa la dmigs pa yang du nyetshad med/ rnam par dag par dmigs pa yang tshad med debu/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du tsoso sor rtog 41—57

pas kun nas nyon mongs pa la dmigs pa/ rnam par dag pa'ishedamigs pa la 'jog pa yang yod do / /yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du so sorasnyirtog pas rnam par dag pa la 4)dmigs pa yang kun nas nyon mongs par dmigs pa la 'jog pa yang yod 5mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi 6)'dzin pas kun nas nyon mongs par dmigs pa la447ci'ajog pa dang / rnam par dag pa'ishedamigs pa la 'jogashepa'ang yod de1 ri/ de la 11snrol zhi'i rnam grangs kyis78de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes 'jug go/ /shā ri'i bu 3nyede bzhin gshegs pa ni ye shes 'di lta bu dang ldan pas 6'dod pa dag 8las dben pa / sdig pa mi dge ba'i hu chos rnams hu)las dben pa19/ 2 rtog pa dang bcas pa (1dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bdemurteb can༄nyebasam gtan dang po rdzogs par byas ( nyete gnas so/ /bsam gtan dang po rdzogs par byas5nyete gnas nas 'gog pa las ldang ba dang / 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs nas bsam gtan dang po las ldang ba'i bar du'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la rjes su 'thun par (stesnyoms par 'jug go/ /mi 'thun par yang5)snyoms par 'jug go/ /rjes su 'thun pa dang mi 'thun dgepar snyoms par 'jug ste rte/ brgyad ces gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ gzugs can gzugs rnams la lta5)ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pasam phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la lta ba 'di sa ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o/ /sdug pa'i rnam par thar pa du nyesdug pa nyid dul mos par 'gyur ba de ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa de ni rnam par thar pa bzhi pa'o/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa de ni rnam par thar pa lnga 47—58

pa'o/ / ci yangatumed pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa de ni rnam par thar pa drug pa'o/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par 'jug pa de ni rnam par thar pa bdun pa'o/ /'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa de ni rnam par thar pa brgyad pa ste/ rnam par thar pa brgyad po 'di dag la rjes su 'thun pa dang / mi 'thun⑧par yang snyoms par 'jug snrel zhir yang snyoms par 'jug tso/ / ting nge 'dzin la yang ting nge 'dzin stonakyil snyoms par 'jug pas rtogs par ston kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la tha dad par 'gyur ba gang yang med/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni ting nge 'dzin la dmigs pa las ting nge 'dzin la mnyam ⑦par gzhag par bya ba meda'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni ting nge 'dzin gcig gis ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'grub po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni ting nge 'dzin las ma bzhengasalgepar ting nge 'dzin thams cad la snyoms par 'jug kyang de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems gcig nas gcig tu 'jug pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi dmigs sonya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni〈kyesus kyang blta7mi nus te/ nyan thos kyi ting nge 'dzin ni rang sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis non 8to/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin ni byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyisacazil gyis non7to/ 9byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis non hu moto/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni zil gyis ma non pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ni zil gyis ma non par 'jug go/ /gdams pa gang dang rjes susnyibastan pa gang gis nyan thos rnams kyitshwanyeting nge 'dzin5) skyed pa de yang de bzhin 41—59

gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen to/ /de bzhin du rang sangs rgyas kyishedang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i ②de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen to/ /mkhyen nas kyang de bzhin du 'doms shing de bzhin du rjes susheston to/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / ldang ba0mkhyen pa'i stobs de ni mtha' yas mu med de⑥/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing mnyam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'atshamede thos nas mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog /som nyi med/ the tshom mi za/ rgya cherashedaga' mgu stenya/ rangs pa rnyed cing nam mkha' lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ngo mtshar dang / rmad du 'du shes skyed do/ / 'di la themachos nyid ni 'di yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /gang gis sems can (rtenyon mongs shing tunye/ /gang gis sems can rnam dag 'gyural/ /de yang dpa' bo chen pos mkhyen/ /mkhyen nas gtam rnams ston par mdzad/ji/ /gang du ma rig skye 'gyur ba/ /nyon mongs rgyu ni tshul bzhin min / /sku de yi 0rkyen ni 'du byed de( sna/ / sdug bsngal rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /(nyesrid pa'i yan lag skyed pa yi/ /thams cad rtsa ba tshul bzhin min/ /de nyid sangs rgyas rab mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin du yang ston par mdzad/ /las kyi rtsa ba rdu )nyon mongs padu skye/ /mi mkhas mngon par 'du byed dedu rnye/ /sdug bsngal 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i bar/ / de yi ni)rkyen ni rnam par shes/ /gang gis sems can dag 'gyur ba/ /rgyu gnyis dang ni rkyen gnyis te/ /gzhan las rjes su 'thun sgra dang / / nang du du /tshul bzhin lta ba'o/ /tshul bzhin rgyu ni zhi 41wa 60

gnas te/ /lhag mthong yang ni rkyen yin no/ /sems can gang gis 'grorashe'agyur ba/ /de yang 'dren pas rab tu mkhyen/ /tshul khrims la ni rnal 'byor gnas / /chos rnams stong par rab tu rtog② /thar pa'i lamakhuni bsgoms pas na/ /srid pa dog las tharasrebar 'gyur/ /de dag sangs rgyas rab mkhyen nas / /rnam sbyongasnyeskyes pa7bud med la/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan med dang / /rnam par thar pa rab tu ston/ /bsam gtan la ni snyoms zhugs ⑦pa/ /rang rgyal dang ni ②nyan thos rnams/ /de dag rnams kyang dog ⑨par bshadatunye / /de ni 'gran zla yod par gsungs(skye/ /sangs rgyas bsam gtan rnam thar la/ /dgra dang bcas med dog〈nyepa med/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni stobs bdun pa/ /pha rol rgol bas thul bar dka'atunye/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyisnyide bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bdun pa ste stobs de dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa7khya mchog gi gnas su zhal gyis 'che7ba nas sus kyang 'jig rten 'dir chos dang 'thun par zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mngon sum du byed pa mkhyen pa'i stobs gang zhe na/ 'di la shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med pa'i ye shes kyis bdag dang sems can gzhan rnams dang / gang zag gzhan dag gi sngon gyi gnas rnamatshwanyepa du ma rjes su dran no/ /'di lta ste/ skye ba gcig gam/gnyis sam/ gsum ma'akho)/ bzhi'am/ lnga 'am/ bcu 'am/(nye nyi shu 'am/sum cu5nye'am/ bzhi bcu 'am/ lnga bcu 'am/(3 skye ba brgya rdunye'am/ skye ba stong ngam/ skye ba brgya stong nas5steskye ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya〈nyestong gi bar du rjes su dran no/ /'jig pa'i bskal du nyepa 'am/ 'chags pa'i bskal pa ( — za'am/41—61

'jig pa dang / 'chags pa'i ①bskal pa 'am/ 'jig pa'i bskal ②pa du ma 'am / 'chags pa'ikhubaskal pa du ma 'am/ 'jig pa dang / 'chags pa'i bskal pa du ma zhig na nga sngon che ge mo zhig tu byung ste/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/rus ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ ⑧zas ni 'di lta bu zhig za zaX/kha dog ni 'di lta bu/ mtshan ma ni 'di lta bu/ dbyibs ni 'di lta bu/ tshe ni 'di tsam zhig thubashe/ yun ni 'di srid cig gnas gnasal/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni 'di lta bu zhig myong stetsho/ bdag de nas shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhig tu skyes so/ /bdag de nas shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes sotsho/ /zhesaca'adi lta bu'i rnam pa dang bcas/ yul phyogs dang bcas/ gzhi ci las gyur pa dang bcas par skobadag dang gzhan gyi sngon gyi gnas tsodu ma rjes su dran no/ /sems can gang gi hu)sngon gyi rgyu ji lta bu〈nyedang / rgyu gang gis sems can du gyur pa'i hu/rgyu de yang de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen te/ mkhyen nas kyang de bzhin du chos ston to/ /'das pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'das pa'i sems can gyi (nge rgyud kyang rab tu mkhyen to(nye/ /sems gang gi 'og tu gang la dmigs pa'i sems skyes pa dang / dmigs pa gang ma tshang bas 'gags pa de thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen to/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu gang sems can gcig gi sems gcig nas gcig tu sems 'di lta bu zhig gi 'og tu sems 'di lta bu zhig zhugebyung ngo / /zhes bya ba de ni bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du yang tshig gis bshad pas ston5)mi nus te/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi yang tsothams cad de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen to/ /tha ma'i mtha'i bar gyi bskal par de bzhin gshegs pas 41—62

sems can ①dag gi sems rnams bshad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i〈sngon gyi zhuganas rjorjes su dran pa mngon sum du byed pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni bsam gyis mi khyabadu/ mtshungs pa med/ tshad med/ grangs med/ brjod du med de dude'i mtha'i gnas ni bde bar bstan mi nus so/ /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog tu gyur pas ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa dusems can de dag la kye sems can rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang deshesangs rgyas la bskyed pa 'am/ nyan thos la bskyed77pa'am / /rang sangs rgyas la bskyed〈nyepa'am/ chos la bskyed 1snyepa de dag dran par gyis shig ces dran par mdzad7do/ /'di lta ste/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi mthus dran par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pas de dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba la dmigs pa de las chos 'di lta5ge'adi lta bur ston te/ ci nas sems can de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing mosalgepa ji lta ba bzhin du la la ni nyan thos kyi theg pas/ la la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas 'byung bar 'gyur motsho/ /la la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyed do/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi gnas yirjes su dran pa mngon sum du byed pa shes pa'i stobs ni mtha' yas mu med de nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing mnyam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'amanyede thos nas/ mngon par dad/ yid ches/ rab tu rtog/som nyi med/ the tshom mi za ba nas/ nam mkha' lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bar du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs te/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad bka' stsal nas ston pasngo )yang 'di skad gsung ngo5 nye/ /41—63

bdag gi dang ni de bzhin gzhan dag gi① /'jig rten sgron mas sngon gyi dran pa ni/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas pa/ /skyu ru ra lnga lag mthil bzhag pa bzhin/ /ming7rusashede bzhin kha dog rnam par rtog /tshe dang gnas dang 'chi 'phos3ci'agro ba dang / /gang gi rgyu la7sems can brtson ldan pa//dus )rimakhyen pa ni de la chos kyang 'chad/ /⑧'gro ba rnams kyi sems dang sems byung chos/ / gang dag 'das pa mtha' yas mu med pa/ /⑨gang gi 'og tu sems gang byung ba kun1bye / /rgyal bsngo)ye shes chen po mnga' bsalgemakhyen/ /sems can gcig gi 8sems rgyusasngon 'das 8pa/ /bde bar gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen pa ni/ /bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed du/ /bshad kyang de yi mtha' /tsho mar phyin mi 'gyur/ /sngon gyi spyod pa ji snyed de dag ni/ /phyi ma'i mtha' yi bar du ngas bshad kyang hu)/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes mi zad de/ /bcom ldan ye shes rgya mtsho 'di 'dra'o/ /sngon gyi rgyal la bstesri stang gang byas shing zhum/ /sems can gang dag dge ba'i bsam gyur gtso/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi shugs la gnas/ /sngon dag dge ba byas pa rnams kyang dran/ /sngon ni bsod nams ci nunye'adra byas pa rnams/ /de dag rnams kyang ston pa'i mthus dran te/ /de dag dran nas gnas ni gsum la 'khod/ / thar pa'i gnas las phyir yang mi ldog 'gyur(ste/ /bde gshegs sngon gyi sbyor ba mtha' yas te / /sems can thams cad kyis ni bsam mi nus/ / mtha' yas grags pa'i stobs ni brgyad pa lazhuge/ /rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po tsodad par 'gyur/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs brgyad pa ste/ stobs de dang sa ldan pas (2zhes bya ba nas chos dang 'thun par5)41—64

zhes bya ①ba'i bar du'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha'i (5)mig rjes su dran pa mngon sum du byed pashemakhyen pa'i stobs gang zhe na/ 'di la shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med pa'i ye shes dang / mi'i〈yelas shin tu 'das pa'i lha'i mig rnam par dag pas sems can rnams 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang ske/ bzang po dang / ngan pa dang / kha dog mdzes pa dang / kha dog mi sdug pa dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba rnams gzigs sonya| /sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis nyes pararnyuspyod pa dang ldan⑨/ ngag gis nyes par spyod pa dang ldan(te/ yid kyis nyes5)par spyod pa dang ldan pahunye/'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ log par lta ba dgasnyiste/ de dag log par lta ba'i las yang dag par blangs pa'i 8rgyus lus zhig ⑩ste/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ⑩ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ / dud 'gro'inyeskye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du'ang de bzhin no/ /yang sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan/ ngag gis legs par spyod pa dang ldan/ yid kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan te/ 'phags pa rnams la skur pa mi 'debs pa yang dag par lta ba ste/ de dag yang dag par lta ba yang dag par blangs pa'i rgyus lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du bu lhar skye'o/ /zhes (nyesems can rnams kyi las ji ltar bsags du nyepa rnams rab tu mkhyen to/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i〈nyelha'i sa mig de ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha'i mtha' chos kyi dbyings tshad med pa/brjod du med pa/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma lasarmānyekyang shin tu 'das pa thams cad57na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang ji snyed snang bar gyur pa (nyede dag 5nyethams cad 41wa 65

ni 'tshig ༅pa dang / 'jig pasadang / 'chags par gzigs sokha/ /sems can gang dag kha cig stisnang bar gyur pa ⑤de dag thams cad ni du'achi 'pho ba dang skye bar gzigs sgodzo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag kha cigasnyesnang bar gyur pa ⑨de dag thams cad ni〈lhadaga' ldan gnas nas 'chi 'pho ba dang ske/ ma'i rum du 'jug pa7dang / btsa' ba dang /⑩ gom pa bdun 'dor geb dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyisnyinang du 'jug pa dang / mngon par 'byung bar gzigs jokho/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag kha cig snang bar gyur pa hu de dag (7thams cad ni ( )byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gzigs so spe/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor 3ba dang / che'i 'du byed 'dor ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ( nyeyang gzigs sodu sge / /nyan thos gang dag kha cigatso snang bar gyur pa du )de dag thams cad ni〈nyeshin tu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas ( nyeyongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar gzigs sodurte/ /rang sangs rgyas gang dag kha cig snang bar gyur pa57de dag thams cad ni0)rdzu 'phrul ston cing yon sbyong bar gzigs so/ /sems can gang dag snang bar ma gyur pa5nyephyi rol gyi drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyi5nyemig gi lam du mi 'gro ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha'i mig gis gzigs cas 7/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pas shing rta'i 'phang 4)lo'i tshad tsam la ri/snang bar ma bu gyur pa'i sems can rnams gzigs pa (7de dag ni shin tu mang gi/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lha dang / mi rnams ni de lta5)ma yin te/ de ltar mi 47wa 66

snang bar gyur pa'i sems can gyi khams kyang tshad med do/ /'di ltar nyu)shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni lha'i mig gis dunanosangs rgyas kyi zhing na ( —)sems can gang sangs rgyas kyis pa'adul bar 'gyur zhes sems can gyi khams la gzigs te/sems can ji tsam sangs rgyas kyis 'dul bar 'gyur ba snyede dag gi mdun na de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs shing 6)sems can de dag 'dul yang sems can gzhan gyis mi shes so/ /de ltar na57)shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha'i mig rjes su dran pa mngon sum du byed pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni mtha' yas mu med de/nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing mnyam mo/ /byang chub sems dpasar3)de thos 9nas mngon par dad pa nas/ nam mkha' lta bur lha tshobasam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid77rgya cher 12bstan pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /nyi bde bar gshegs pa'i lha/mig dri med de'/ /bskal pa bye bar tshadage ba'i las kyis sbyangasami / / des ni rgyal bas phyogs bcu sangs rgyas zhing / /rgya chen bsam gyis mi khyab rnams kyang gzigs/ /18'byung ba dang ni 'jig pa ji snyed pa/ /kha cig me yis 'khor cing sems can gnas3rto/ /kha cig sangs rgyas ldan zhing snakha cig stong / /thams cad rang byung gi ni spyan gyis gzigs(1/ /sems can khams ni rgya chen bsam mi khyab/ /gzugs can gzugs med gang dag ji snyed dang ske/ /gang dag ngan 'gror ltung 22dang bder zhu 'gro ba/ /thams cad rang byung gi ni spyan gyis gzigs byu/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mang po gang bzhugs dang / /rang byung ge'adren pa mya ngan gang 'das dang si/ /rang rgyal gang dang nyan thos gang yod patri / /thams cad rang byung gi ni spyan gyis gzigs na/ /byang chub 41—67

sems dpa' srog chags phan 'dod7pa/ /gang dag byang chub spyod pa mchog spyod cing / /la la gzhi med5miganas ni rtog gyur7pa/ /thams cad rang byung 'dren pa dag gis gzigs④/ /gang gis srog chags shin tu phra mthong ba/ /bde gshegs mig ni 'di 'dra dri ma med/ /mig stobs bsam gyis mi khyab dgu pa ste/ /rgyal sras des pa rnams ni mngon par dad/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dgu pa ste/ stobs de dang ldan pas 5khya mchog gi gnas su zhal gyis 'che7zhing 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra yang dag par sgrog pa nas/ sus kyang 'jig rten 'dir chos dang 'thun pa0)zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag pa zad pa mngon sum du byed pa mkhyen ⑨pa'i stobs gang zhe na/ 'di la shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa nyu sibla na med pa'i tunye de bzhin gshegs pa'i 4)ye shes kyi stobs kyisalgezag pa 8thams cad zad pas bdag skye ba ni zad/ tshangs par spyod pa la ni bstenam / bya ba ni byas te⑩/ 'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so zhes zag pa med pa/ sems rnam par grol ba/ rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum dusngonebyas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i0zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs de ni bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi theg pasngo nyepa'i zag pa zad pa ni tshad du byas pa'i bag chags yang dag par bcom pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa༄nyezag pa zad pa ni tshad yod pa ste/ snying rje chen po dang bral ba/ spobs pa dang bral ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag pa zad pa ni rnam pa5)thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa 2ribag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad yang dag par 41—68

bcom pa/ snying rje chen pos7kun tu7bzung ba/ mi 'jigs pa dngas/spobs pa la ④lta ba 'jig rten thams cad kyis zil gyis mi non pa ste/ skad cig gcigasnyedang ldan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la las kyi bag chags med/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags med/ spyod lam 'khrul pa'i bag chags med do/ /'di lta ste/ shā ri'i bu nam mkha' yongs su dag pas rdul dang du ba'i 'khrug pa dang lhan cig tu mi gnas pa de bzhin du shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs kyang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags thams cad dang lhan cig tu mi gnas so/ /de zag pa zad par mkhyen〈pepa de lta bu la rab tu gnas nas zag pa dang bcas patsha༅len pa dang bcas pa'i sems can rnams la zag pa zad par bya ba'ispyiphyir chos ston to/ /len pa spang ba'i7phyir chos ston tokyi/ /kye ma sems can rnams ni〈nyeyang dag pa ma yin pa kun7rtog pa las byung ste/ zag pa dang / len pa rnams mi bskyed pa'i phyir yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du khyed7kyis rab tu rtogs shig ces/ de dag la de bzhin gshegs pas dpekhedang tshul gyis ci hunyenas kyang zag pa rnams yang dag pa ma yin pa'o zhes yang dag par ji lta ba bzhinashirab tu5nyeshes par 'gyur zhing shes5)nas kyang chos gang yang mi len te/ len pa med par〈 )yongs su mya ngan las du nya'ada' bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltadza )bur chos ston to/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas sems can thams cad kyi zag pa rnams rab tu mkhyen to/ /zag pa kun 'byung ba dang / zag pa 'gagarmā pa dang / zag pa 'gag par 'gyur ba'i lam yang yang stidag pa ji lta ba bzhin (nyerab tu mkhyen te mkhyen nas0lhakyang de bzhin du chos ston to/ /byang chub sems dpasam de bzhin gshegs pa'i 41wa 69

zag pa zad pa mngon sum du byed pa mkhyen pa'i stobs de thos nas mngon par dad / yid ches/ rab tu rtog① /som nyi med cing the tshom mi za ba nas ngo mtshar dang rmad kyi bar dula'adu shes skyed do/ / 'di lasachos nyid ni 'di yin te / de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /'dren pa'i zag pa med pa'i ye shes ni/ /rgya dun)chen sgrib med dag pa tshad med de⑥/ /⑦stobs bcu'i stobs ni desnyedang ldan pas na/ /zhi ba'i ⑨byang chub mchog 'di rab tu gsung ⑩/ /nyan thos rnams kyi zag zad yi77shes ni/ /bag chags ma bcom tshad dang ldan pa yin//mi yi dam pa 'dren pa mchog rab kyi7/ /bag chags bcom zhing tshad dang ldan ma 8yin/ /de bzhinatsorang rgyal byang chubalgegang reg pa/ /de la snying rje che dang spobs pa med/ /bcom ldan 'das ni zag pa yongs zad pa(3/ /snying rje che dang spobs pa tshad med do/ /sangs rgyas zag zad mkhyen5)la gnas nas ni( ske/ /'gro ba'i zag pa yang dag ma yin zhing〈 tshe/ / rigs pa'i gnas kyi tshul 'di ma shes pas/ ( nyechos 'di thams cad log par zhugs mkhyen te( nye/ /(stede la rgyal ba snying rje rinacher bskyed nasatso/ /chos 'di5 rtemi rtag stong pa bdag med chos / /dngos med gsog ste༄nyemachog tu zhi ba yidu rte/ /sa la rtogs shing ltos shes rab tu ston / /'di la skyes bu srog dang gang zag dang / /shed skyes shed bubartebyed pa po yang 2med/ /chos 'di thams cad log par chags stepas na/ /ston pa snying rje bskyed nas thar ston kyang / /bde bar gshegs la skyo ba yod med de / /yang dag ye shes nams kyang nyams pa med/ /de'i phyir5nyergyal ba rtag tu rnal 'byor sbyor zhi/ /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams rab tu ston/ /'di ni pha rol smra ba 'joms pa'itshwanyestobs/ /mtha' yas nam snyemakha' 'dra ba rtebacu pa 41—70
