sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi7byams pa chen po bsgomakhupa'i dge ba'i⑧ma bsreni dpag tu med pa yin te/ gzhon nu de'i byams pa ni bdag srung ba yin/gzhan la phan par gnas pa yin⑦/ mchog tu gnod sems med pani/ khro ba dang gnod sems kyi tha ba dang bral ba/ nyes pa 'joms pa rjes su ⑨chags pa'i kun nas ldang ba dang bral ba/ dad pa kun tu 8ston pa 'khrul pa thams cad la nyes par lta7ba/ yongs su gdung ba med pa/ lus dang / ngag dang /sems bde ba skyed pa/ gzhan gyi gnod par bya ba thams cad du ma ltung5nyeb/'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba 'phags pa'i lam dang 'thun pa/ gshe ba dang khros pa la dang ba skyed pa/ g.yul thams cad las sgrol ba/ dbyig pa dang mtshon cha mi thogs pa8/ sems can rab tu thar bar bya ba la dga' ba/khong khro ba thams cad dang bral ba/ tshul 'chos pa dang / kha gsag dang /'drid pa dang / gzhogs slong7thams cad dang bral ba/ rang gi rnyed7pa dang ske/ bkur sti dang / tshigs su bcad pas nye bar mi'atsho ba/ brgya byin dang ske/ tshangs pas phyag byas pa/ rang gi tunyegazi brjid kyis tu)brgyan pa/mkhas pas bstod pa ⑦/ byis pa thams cad rjes su srung lhab/ tshangs pa'i lam dang 'thun pa/ 'dod pa'i khams dang ma 'dres pa/ thar pa'i lam gyi gtso bor gyur pa/ theg pa thams cad kyis yang dag par bzung zhunyeb/ zang zing med pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags byapa/ rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi zing gyis mi non pa/ mtshan sum cu5 nyertsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang pos yang dag par brgyan pa/ dbang po nyams shing ma tshang ba thams cad spangs pa/ bde 'gro dang / mya ngan las du rkye41—127

'da' ba'i lam thams cad du 'gro ba/ ngan song thams cad dang / mi khom pa brgyad las zlogs7pa/ chos kyi kunashedaga'akhul dga' zhing mos pa/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad dang / dbang po dang / rgyal srid la mngon par mi dga' ba dngane no/ sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems kyis/ sbyin pa 5)rab tu sbyor ba/ tha dad pa'i 'du shes dang bral ba/ tshul khrims dang bslab pa thams cad kyis6༄sgo dang las// tshul khrims 'chal pa'uthams cad kyi skyabs1—/ bzod pa'i stobs kun tu ston pa/ nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang /dregs pa thams cad dang bral ba/ mi 'khrugs pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa/yang dag par sna nisbyor ba'i bya ba sgrol ba/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i rtsa ba/ nyon mongs pa las byung ba/ sems nges par rtogs /tshepa/ thos pa 'dzin pal)/ shes rab kyi rgyu skyed pa'i byams pa/ bdag gi phyogs dang gzhan gyi phyogs 'joms tunyepa/bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i phyogs sel ba/ 'grogs na bde ba/ ldang ba dang /slong ba dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal ba'i spyod lam srungachabar byed pa/ rgod pa'i rang bzhin 'ayid la byed pa thams cad (zhesel ba/ dri zhim pos byugs pa/khrel yod pa dang ngo tsha shes pas nyu ༷byugs pa/ mi khom pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang ske/ ngan 'gro nyunyethams cad sel ba'i byams pahurte/ 'gro ba thams cad skyob pa'i sa nibyams pa chen po/ bdag gi bde ba btang ba dang〈 7/ sems can thams cad la bde ba rab tu sbyin pa ste/ gzhon nu nyan thos rnams kyi byams pa ni bdag skyob pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis)byams pa ni sems can thams cad la skyob pa'o/ /yang gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po 41—128

bskyed pa rnams kyi byams pa ni sems can la7dmigs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'akhuspyod pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi byams pa ni〈chos la dmigs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa rab tu thob pa rnams kyi byams pa ni dmigs pa med pa'odu / / gzhon nusnyi'adi ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byams pa zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa de la rab tu gnas pas sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byed do/ /de la gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po gang zhe na/ gzhon nu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni snying rje chen po'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper nashegazhon nu skyes bu'i srog gi dbang po'i sngon du 'gro ba ni dbugs〈'byung ba dang rngub pa'o1)/ /gzhon nu de bzhin du theg pa chen po kyiyang dag par sgrub (spepa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni snying rje chen po'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na 12gzhon nu 'khor los sgyuratshwanyeba'i rgyal po'i7rin po che7thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ni 'khor lo rin po che yin no/ /gzhon nu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ni snying rje chen po yin te / snying rje chen po de yang sems can thams cad rjes su mi gtong ba'o/ /gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po rkyu 7sems can thams cad la ji ltar 'jug ce na/ gzhon nu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' nyunye'ajig tshogs la lta bas bcings shing lta bar gyur pa rnam patshwa)mang po la chags pa'i zhu sems can mthong na/ de dag gi 'jig tshogs la01lta bas bcings pa spang ba'i phyir chos bstan 6to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i 2gesnying rje chen po 41—129

'jug go/ /gzhan yang gzhon nu byang chub sems dpasatu sems canakhuyang dag pa ma yin pas phyin ci log gi gnas la gnas te/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shes pa dang / sdug bsngal ba la bde bar 'du shes pa dang / bdag med pa la bdag tu 'du shes pa dang / mi sdug pa la sdug par 'du shes pa mthong na / de dag gis geyang dag pa ma yin pa'i phyin ci log spang ba'i phyir chos bstan ri to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i ④snying rje chen po 'jug go/ / gzhan yang gzhon nu ⑧byang chub sems dpas ④phyin ci log gi 'dod pa la sred 8pa'i sems can de dag ma la yang5tegayem pa dang / sring mo la yang g.yem pa mthong na/ byang chub sems dpa' hunye'adi snyam du sems te/kye ma'o 'jig rten gnas pa 'di dag hurteni 'phags pa ma yin pa 'dus pa ste/mu cor smra bas yongs su gang zhing ngo tsha mi shesalgepas yongs su gang ngo / /'di ltar ma'i rum tshamangal gyi mal na 'dug 'dug stom/ de nyid kyi5)mngal gyi sgo nas byung la de nyid dang yang lhan cig tu 'dod pa sten tunyepar byed pa lta ga la srid( bye / mngal gcig na lhan cig tetu 'dug5nye'adug pa'i sring mo dang 'du zhing 'khrig pa (nyebyed pa lta ga la srid de( snye/ kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni brlag go/ / rnam par brlag go/bu /rab tu brlag go/ /'dod chags kyis g.yen spyo'o( / /zhe snang gis g.yen spyo'o( nye/ /gti mug gis g.yen spyo'o ⑦/ /mi shes pas g.yen spyo'o(4 sdu/ /chos las nyams shing chos ma yin pa la gnas so/ / mi 'thun07pa'i chos la rab tu spyod do/ /sems can dmyal ba'i5)spyod yul pa'o / / dud 'gro'i0)skye gnas kyi stespyod yul pa'o/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi5snyespyod yul pa'o/ /log pa'i lam la spyod yul pa'o snyam sna'i9/ /gzhon nu 'di 41—130

lta ste dper natuwa dur khrod kyi mthar g.yang sa chen po dang nye ba zhig na mtshan mo khyis gtses nas g.yang sa chen po ②nas ltung ba ni de bzhin du ④gzhon nu ⑤sems can 'di dag kyang wa dang 'dra'o/ /gzhon nu 'di lta ste/ dper na dmus long khyisashegatses nasamagugayang sa chen po dang nye bar gyur pa7de bzhin du/ kye ma'o gzhon nu sems can 'dirwanyedag kyang dmus long dang 'dra'o/ /gzhon nu 'di lta ste/ dper nasaphaganyeniphamami gtsang ba za zhing mi gtsang ba la spyod yul pa stetsho/ gzhon nu kye ma'o de bzhin du sems can 'di dag kyang phag dang 'dra stetsho/ de nyid ma yin/ de nyid sring mo yin na/ de chung mar bya ba lta yig la srid snyam ste/ sems can (kyenyon mongs pas g.yen spyo ba ( tre dang /bdud kyi phyogs kyi spyod yul palo dang / bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pa dang5nye/'dod pa'i 'dam du dubying ba de dag ( nyegi 'dod pa thams cad spang ba'i phyir chos bstan to/ /zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'isnyi snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas sasgrib pa lngas bsgribs pa'i sems can 'dod pa'i zug rngus zug pa mthong na/ skye mched drug la chags shing zhen pa/ mig gis( 7gzugs mthong na/ mtshan mar 'dzin par 'gyur zhing mngon rtags suke 'dzin pa dang / rna bas sgra/ snas dri/( lcesamu 3ro/ lus kyis reg pa la reg na cetematshan mar 'dzin cing mngon rtags su (rte'adzin par 'gyur te/ kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni khong khro ba mang zhing phan tshun mi mdza' ste/ de dag don rnyed pa'i duphyir ni mdza' bor yang mi shes/gnod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ni gcig la (stegacig gsod (nyedo/ /kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni gnyid dang rmugs pa mang brwate ste/ zhen0)cing spong sheb mi shes 41wa 131

pa'i ling tog gis mi khebs shing mi dge ba'o②/ /kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni 'gyod ripas kun nas bskor ba ste/ blosnyigur gyi nyon mongs pas sems kun nas nyon mongs pa'o/ /kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni the tshom gyis7yongs su dkris pa chos zab mo la nges par ma gyur4)pa ste/ de dag gi5/sgrib pa thams cad spang ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes ⑧ sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i59)snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems can nga rgyal gyis non pa/ che ba'i nga rgyal gyisamanyanon pa/ nga rgyal las kyang nyi nga rgyal gyis non pa/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis non pa/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis non pa/ cung zad snyam pa'i〈nyeng rgyal gyis non pa/ log pa'i nga rgyal gyis non pa/ dma' ba bas 8bdag mtho bar sems pa/ mtshungs pa bas kyang bdag ches lhag par lta ba de dag gzugs la bdag ces khas len pa nas/ tsho / rnam par shes pa'i bar la bdag ces khas len pa/ khong du ma chud par khong du chud 12snyam du shes pa/ gus par smra bar 'os pa la gus par mi smra ba3)ske/ phyag bya bar 'os pa la phyag mitshu )'tshal ba/ rgan pa dang / gzhon pa la mi 'dud pa/ bla ma la rim gro du 1mi byed pa/ mkhas pa la dge ba gang / mi dge ba gang / bsten du par bya ba gang / bston par mi bya ba gang / bya ba gang ske/ mi bya ba gang / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang / kha na ma tho ba med pa gang / lam gang / ting nge 'dzin gang / rnam par grol ba gang zhes mi 'dri ba dang / bdag nyid la bdag nyid na ni gtso bo'oni bye/ /bdag ni mchog go snyam du rlom sems su byed pa nisnyemathong na 'di ltar nga rgyal gyi57rnam pa thams cad spang ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i shu lhe41—132

snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas sridamagyo)pa'i bcing bas bcings pa②/ sredashepas 'khol ba/ chung ma dang / bu pho54dang ske/ bu mos zin pa/ gnod pas zin pa/ don med pas zin pa/'khor ba'i gtanasazin pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'im 1skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam gyis zinalo④pa/ srid pa'i bcing bsashezin pa/ rang nyam7med pa/ rang dbang med pa'i sems can mthong na/de dag rang nyam dang / rang dbang dang / gang du dga' bar 'gro ba dang /mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i〈nyasnying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas5rnyedage ba'i bshes gnyen 1lhadang bral ba/ sdig pa'i grogs pos 'khol ba de dag tunyesdig pa'i grogs pos non pas mi dge ba'i las 1gel chags pa 8'di lta ste/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin paratshwa 7len pa dang /'dod pa la53log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang /ngag rtsub po dang / tshig kyal pa dang / brnab ( 3sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba'i sems can mthong na 'di ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsdu ba dang / mi dge ba'i las las 31bzlog pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par bzung ste/ spyod par bya ba'i phyir shustechos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sa snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpasadza stegati mug gis bsgribs pa/ ma rig pa'i mun pa mun nag gi ling tog gis kun tu 3nyebasgribs pa/ bdag dang /sems can dang / srog dang / skye ba po ginyadang / shed las skyes pa dang /41—133

shed bu dang /ri1 skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / byed pa po dang / tshor ba po dang / ngar 'dzin pa dngashe/ nga yirakhu'adzin pa la mngon par chags pa'i sems can mthong na de dag 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi mig rnam par sbyangasakyizhing lta bar gyur pa thams cad spang ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas ⑦'khor ba la mngon par dga' ba'i sems can mthong na de dag phung po lnga'i gshed ma las rab tu thar bar bya ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa las rab tu bzla7ba dang / khams gsum thams cad las gdon 1)pa'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu gzhan (nyuyang byang chub sems dpas ⑫sems can 'khrugs par gyur pa/ rnacamun dza dang / bal ba dza lta bu mi drang ba drang ba ltar 'chos pa'i/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol dutso/ 'jig rten pha rol nas 'jig rten 'dir kun tu rgyug cing 'khor ba/ 'gro ba lngar 'gro ba la phyogs pa/ mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba la phyir bltas pa〈nyemathong na de dag gi mya ngan las 'da' ba'i sgo dbye ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i tsosnying rje chen po 'jug go/ /gzhon nu de ltar byang chub sems dpas bu sems can gyi khams mthong na rnam nyepa bcu po 'di dag gis ri 2snying rje chen po 'jug go/ /bsam pa las byung ba'i phyir gnyede'i snying rje chen po de yang g.yo bam med par 'jug go/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa las shin tu nidebyung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang mnyam par 'jug go/ /lam las byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang drang po bcos ma ma yin (nye41—134

par 'jug go/ /sems gya gyu med pa'i sems las shin tunyeganas pa las byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang gya gyu med par 'jug goX/ /'di lta ste/sems can thams cad la 'dud pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba las shin ②tu byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang bdag gi bde ba gtong bar 'jug go/ /'di lta ste/ bdag gi sems yongs su dag pa las byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang pha rol rjes su srungasnyibar 'jug go/ /'di lta ste/ g.yo7zhing 'gul ba'i sems dang bral bsherab tu gnas pa'i'usems las byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang shes rab brtan par 'jug go/ /'di lta ste/ pha rol la bde ba sbyin pa las rab tu byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang bdag gi bde7ba gtong bar 'jug go/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa las5)byung ba'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po de yang sems can thams cad kyi khur khyer tsobar 'jug stetsho/ gzhon nu 'di ltar⑥byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po ni rnam pa 'di dag dang gzhan yang rnam pa bcus 'jug go/ /gzhon nu 'di ltar gang la la theg pa chen pos nges par7)'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad5rnyekyang snying rje chen pos 'byung steX/ de'i phyir snying rje chen po zhes bya'o/ /sbyin pa byed pa dang / tshul khrims byed pa dang / bzod pa byed pa dang / brtson 'grus byed pa dang / bsam gtan byed pa dang / shes rab byed pa ni snying rje chen po zhes bya5)ste/ de'i phyir snying rje chen po zhes bya'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa byed pa dang / yang dag par spong ba byed pas snying rje chen po'o/ /dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / mchog tu dga' bar bya ba'i las dang (rte/ mthar gyis snyoms par 'jug pa 41—135

dang ske/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang / tshigs3)de dag thams cad kyang〈rgyas par bya'o// /snying rje chen po ni rang byung gi'agele shes sgrubalgepar byed pas nal)de'i phyir snying rje chen po zhes bya'o/ /rang gi bya ba dang / legs par byed pa'i bya ba menadang / mi 'gyur ba'i bya ba58)dang / sems can thams cad la bya bsaspuci yod snyam pa ste/ de'i snying rje chen po de yang sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par byed pas 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 6snying rje chen po zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje de nyu7dang ldan pas sems can 'di 'dra ba'i gnas thob pa mthong na de dag la snying brtse ba dang snying rje'i 1)sems skyed do/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba gang zhe na/ gang dge ba'i chos rnams dran pa dang ske/ rjes su dran pa dang / dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dge ba'i chos la mi zhum pa dang / mi 'gong ba dang /yongs su mi skyo ba dang / mi dga' ba thams cad spong ba dang / chos thams cad la dga' bar gnas pa dang / sems rab tu dga' ba dang / lus rab tu sim sna pa dang / blo rab tu dga' ba dang / yid rab tu mgu ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la mngon par dga' zhing mos pa dang / mtshan dang /dpe byad bzang po'i79rgyan kun tu tshol ba la tshedaga' ba skyedang / chos nyan pas yongs su mi skyo zhing dga' ba dang / chos kyi phyir 'brang ba'i nan tan la rab tu dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i 1 tshochos la mgu ba dang / sems can rnams nyushel khong khro ba med pa dang / byang chub la dga' ba dang / chos rgya chen po la mos pa dang / nyi 3tshetshe ba'i theg pa sel bar sems bskyed pa dang / ser 41—136

sna tshar gcod pa dang / slong ba la dga' ba dang / gtong ba la rab tu dga' ba dang / tshul khrims 'chal pa0)dag sdud cing5gebyams pa dang / tshul khrims dang ldan pa la rtagashetu dad pa dang / bdag gi tshul khrims yongs su dag pas ngan 'gro dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las rab tu 'da' ④bar dbugs 'byinapo)pa la rab tu dga' ba dang / pha rolalo3)ngan du zer ba dang / ngan par brjodashepa'i tshig gi lam bzod cing rab tu dga' ba dang / lag pa dang /rkang pa dang / mig dang mgo⑧bcad kyang bzod par 7nus te/ sems mi nyams shing rab tu dga' ba dang / rgan rabs skyal 'dud cing zhe sa byed pa la dga' ba dang / rtag tu bzhin 'dzum pa la dga' ba dang / khro gnyer med cing gsong por smra ba la dga' ba dang / tshul 'chos pa dang / kha gsag hunyadang ske/ gzhogs slongs3)med pa la rab tu dga' ba dang / snying po dang ldan pa'i chos la 8'jug par rab tu dga' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa bzhin du phangs ⑩pa dang / chos la bdag bzhin du phangs 7pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa la srog bzhin du phangs ⑩pa dang bla ma la pha ma bzhin du phangs ⑩pa dang / sems can thams cad la bu bzhin du phangs tu)pa dang /slob dpon la mig bzhin du phangs 3)pa dang / nan tan la yan lag gi dam pa mgodza )bzhin du phangs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la lag pa dang /ni1 rkang pa bzhin du phangs pa dang / chos smra ba la rin po che thams cad bzhin du phangs nirtepa dang / chos yongs su tshol ba la sman bzhin du phangs ni/pa dang / skul〈 nazhing dran par byed pa la sman pa bzhin du phangs trisnyepar 3 tshosems pa'o/ /gzhon nu 'di ni dga' ba zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dga' ba 41—137

de la rab tu gnas nas rtag tu chos tshol ba la dga' bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa la mi skyo'ohu)/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi btang snyoms gang zhe na/ btang snyoms rnam pa gsum ste/ rnam pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nyon mongs pa la btang snyoms pa dang / bdag dang gzhan rjes su srung ②ba'i btang snyoms pa dang / dus dang dus ma yin par btang snyoms pa'o/ /de la nyon mongs pa'i btang snyoms pa gang zhe na/ gang bkur sti na byas kyang mthor mi sems pa dang / bkur sti ma byas kyangasnyedama' bar mi sems pa dang / rnyed pas snyems pa med pa dang / ma rnyedakyipas yi mi 'chad pa dang choge/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang / tshul khrims 'chal7pa la blo mnyam pa dang / grags pa la dga' ba med pa dang / ma grags pa la zhum pa med pa dang / smad pa la yi mi gsod pashedang / bstod pa la chos nyid du shin tu gnas pa dang / sdug bsngal la7 so sor51rtog pa'i stobs dang / bde ba la mi rtag par7rtog pa'i stobs dang / rjes su7chags pa 'dor ba dang /khong khro ba spong ba dang / mdza' ba dang mi mdza'akheb lasnyisems mnyam pa dang /legs par byas pa dang / nyes par77byas pa la gnyis su mi 'byed pa dang / sdug pa dang mi sdug pa 1snyel mi lta ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang /bsnyen bkur mi byed pa la dga' ba dang mi dga' bar bya ba med ()pa dang /snyan par smra ba dang / mi snyan par smra ba la rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba med pa dang / kun myang ba'i rdul ninyes pa la mtshungs par yongs su 'jal ba (skyedang ske/ bdag dang sems can gzhan la bsam pa mnyam pa dang / lus dang srog la mi lta ba dang / sems can rab 'bring tha ma la 'od zer (3mnyam pa 41—138

dang / bsngags pa dang mi7bsngags pa la chos nyidakhumanyam pa dang / bden pa dang / mi bden pa la bdag gi bden⑧pa yongs su dag pa ste/ gzhon nu 'di ltar gang bdag la gnod par byed pa de la byang chub sems dpa' btang snyoms pa yin no0/ /de la bdagasnyedang gzhan rjes su srung ba'i btang snyoms gang zhe na/ gang yan lag dang yinying lag gi sha bcad kyang btang snyoms pa yin no/ /yan lag dang nying lag gi sha bcad kyang / 'dod pa med cing tshol ba med de btang snyoms pa yin no/ /lus kyang mi 'gyur/ ngag kyang mi 'gyur te/ gnyi ga⑧bzod pas de'i phyir btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /mig gi rnam pas ma yin/ gzugs kyi rnam pas ma yin te/ gnyi gas7kyang rma mi phyin pa nas/ yid kyi rnam pa dang / chos kyi rnam pa'i bar gyis rma mi phyin pas de'i phyir btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /rma mi phyin cing snang ba med pas de'i phyir btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /rma phyung ba la rma mi 'byin hu)pas de'i phyir btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /bdag dang pha rol gnyi ga lasatshwa bzod pas de'i phyir btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /phan par byedasnyipa dang / phan par mi byed7pa la mnyam par sbyor bas de'i phyir btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /btang snyoms ni7rtsod pa med pa lhur byed pa'o/ /btang snyoms ni rang gi semasarwanyenges par rtog pa'o/ /btang snyoms ni bdag la so sor rtog pa'o/ /btang snyoms ni gzhan la gnod pa med pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi btang snyoms ni mnyam par gzhag pa'i dngos po stote/ (kye sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nirmānyebyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la〈 nyebatang snyoms pa gnang bar mi mdzad blo //de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpas rtag tu 'bad hepar bya'o/ /rtag 41wa 139

par rgyun mi 'chad par ①dge ba yongs su nibatsal ba la brtson par bya ②ste/dus dus su btang snyoms bsgomasrepar bya'o/ /de la dus dus su btang snyoms bsgom pa pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snod ma yin pa'i sems can la btang snyoms pa dang / bsnyen bkur mi byed pa la btang snyoms pa dang / ma rnyed pa dang ske/ pismad pa dang / ma grags pa dang / sdug bsngal ba la rtsibatang snyoms pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg par nges par 'gyur ba la〈khuzhugs pa rnams7la btang snyoms pa dang / sbyin pa'i dus na/tshul khrims nye bar bsgrub pasngon/btang snyoms pa 1 dang / tshul khrims kyi dus na sbyin pa nye bar bsgrub pa hu btang snyoms pa 1 nodang / bzod pa'i dus na sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /brtson 'grus nye bar bsgrub pa bebatang snyormes pa tsodang / brtson 'grus kyi hurtedus na tshul khrims kyi rjes su 'jug pa lha btang snyoms pa /tsho)dang / bsam gtan gyi dus na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nye bar bsgrub pa ( ste btang snyoms pa ( rtsedang /shes rab kyi dus na tri pha rol tu phyin pa lnga la dmigs pa nye bar bsgrub pa 3nyebatang snyoms pa ste zhe/ 'di ni dus dus su〈gebatang snyoms pa 39zhes bya'o/ /de ltar gang mi bya ba'i chos mi byed pa 'di ni btang snyoms zhes bya ste/ de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni ni mi dge ba'i phyogs thams cad lamanyebatang snyoms su byed dos / /gzhon nu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rjes nodang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms zhes bya'o/ /de ltar shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po des gzhon07nu brtson 'grus spyod la byams pa dang / snying rje dang ske/ dga' ba dang / btang snyoms mdor bstan pa dang bcas/ rgyas 41wa 140

par bstan pa dang bcas te/ rgya cher yang dag par bstan to①/ /gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod des dekhuthos nas pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson 'grus brtsamasasnyepar gyur to/ /byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de la shā ri'i bu pha rol tu phyin pa rnamasashel brtson pa gang zhe na/ shā ri'i bu pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag nyid yin te/ gang pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'disnyedag la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nimanyabyang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod dopha/ /drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang lta brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug rnams so/ /de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' nilo7dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / phongs pa rnams kyi sbyin bdag yin te/ 'di lta ste/ zas kyis phongs pa la zas/ skom gyis phongs pa la skom/ bzhon71pa dang / gos dang / spos72dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gnas dang / yo byad dang / na ba'i gsosarwa༄sman dang ske/ mar me dang / sil snyan dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang /gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya skodang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi ru dang / rin po che thams cad dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta dang / skyedachamos tshal dang / dka'apha thub kyi nags 41wa 141

tshalatudang / bu midang / bu mo dang / chung ma dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang ba dang / gling bzhi'i rgyal po'i longs spyod kyi bde ba thams cad dang / rtse ba dang / dga' ba thams cad dang / lag pa dang /rkang pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / mig dang / mgo dang / sha dang /khrag dang / rkang dang / rus pasadang / 'jig rten gyi yo byad gang yang slong ba la ri4)yongs su mi gtong ba med do/ /sbyin pa de rnam pa bcus yongs su dag par ri sbyin par byed de/ bcu gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mi 'thun pa'i 6)longs spyod yongs su ④tshol zhing sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sems can ⑧la gnod pa'i sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la tsa)'jigs shing skrag nas sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 9yongs su ma btang ba la 'gron du gnyer ba'i〈nyesbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdong 7du lta hunyezhing sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sems can la tsotha dad par sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lalamadza' bas sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la snang bas sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhing tshol zhing sbyin pa med / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la〈nyesems can thams cad la sbyin gnas ma yin zhes brnyas shing /)sbyin pa med de )/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa de rnam pa de bcus yongs su dag par sbyin par byed doha/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' du 2sbyin pa de gzhan (3rnam pa bcus yongs su dag par sbyin par byed de/ bcu gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la stelas kyi rnam par smin pa 'dod cing sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 41—142

latubasam pa log par7sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lakhuyongs su skyo ba'i sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la53)nye bar bstan nas sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lasnyirjes su mi dga' ba'i7sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la7)'gyod pa'i sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ②tshul khrims dang ldan pa la bkur te she)sbyin pa med/ tshul khrims 'chal pa la brnyas te sbyin pa med/tso byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ⑩rnam par smin pa 8re ba'i sbyin pa med de/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa de rnam pa de (sribacus yongs su dag par sbyin par byed do/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa de gzhan 8rnam pa bcus yongs su dag par sbyin par byed de8/ bcu gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la smad nas sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnamasatshwa)la〈nyegazhan du phyogs nas sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la tu)nyon mongs sno)shing sbyin pa med/ khro ba dang / phrag dog dang / gnod sems ston cing sbyin pa med/ ri mor mi byed par sbyin pa med/ rang gi lag nas ma yin par sbyin nyepa med/ ci tsam dpags〈 nyepa las dbri zhing sbyin pa med( nye/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams skye ba 'dod cing〈 stesbyin pa med de snye/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa de rnam pa de bcus yongs su dag par sbyin par byed do / /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa de gzhan rnam pa bcus yongs su dag par sbyin par〈 )byed de/ bcu gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yimi brtan par sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 0tshod 'dzin cing sbyin pa med/ yongs su chad par sbyin pa med/41—143

gzhan gyi dring 'jog ste sbyin7pa med/ nyung zhes cung zad tsam sbyin⑧pa med/gzugs dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyugashel mngon par dga' ba'i sbyin pa med ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lamagebargya byin dang / tshangs pa dang ske/ 'jig rtenama'uskyong ba dang / lhar skye ba thams cad 'dod pa'i sbyin pa med / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mnyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo gzhing sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ⑨mkhas pas smad pa'i sbyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la thams cad mkhyen par 31ma bsngos nyi pa'i sbyin pa med de/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' tunyesbyin pa de k+ṣarnam pa de gebacus yongs su dag par sbyin par byed dos/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa de gzhan rnam pa bcus yongs su dag par sbyin 1 par byed de)snye/ bcu gang zhe na/ ji4)tsam〈 )'dus byas las nges parasnyi'abyung ba 2 dang / 'dus ma byas thob par bya ba'i phyir de ltar sbyin pa byin na/shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i du musbyin pa'i phan yon gigebacu 'thob par 'gyur ro / /bcu gang zhe na/ bza' ba byin pas 25tshe dang / spobs pa dang / bde ba dang / stobs dang / kha dog 'phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /btung ba byin pas nyon mongs pa dang / sred pa thams cad bsal bsngo nyephun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob tsunyebo/ /bzhon tshepa byin pas bde ba thams cad kyi dngos po phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /bgo bar )byin pas5nyekhril yod pas dang / ngo tsha shes02pa dang / gser ltar kha dog yongs su dag pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /sposam dang phreng ba byin pas tshul khrims dang /thos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis dri dang / byug pa5nyephun tshosum〈petshogs pa 41wa 144

rab tu 'thob bo/ /dri rab tu0)zhim pa'i sposaphudang / phye ma dang / byug pa〈yibyin pas lus kyi nan tan gyi dri zhim po phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /ro byin pas ro bro ba'i nang na mchog gi ro bro ba'i skyes bu chen po'itshang)mtshan phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /gnas byin pas sems can thams cad kyi gnas dang / rten dang / gling dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyenasaphun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /nad pa la sman byin pas mi rga〈nyami 'chi shi ba med pa'i bde ba yongs su rdzogs pa7phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo yo byad sna tshogs byin pas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyi yo byad yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa〈kyerab tu 'thob stenya/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' byang chub 'dod pas tsode ltar sbyin pa byin na sbyin pa'i phan yon nyi bcu po de dag yongs su gzung bar 'gyur brte/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' phan yonachagazhan bcu rab tu 'thob bo/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/mar me7byin7pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan lnga yongs su dag pamo phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /sil snyan byin pas lha'i rna ba yongs su dag pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /gser dang /6) nor bu dang / mu tig dang ske/ be+e drur+ya7tshedang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / rin po che thams cad byin pas skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu dzo — rtsa gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /rin po che tha dad pa sna tshogs dang ske/ me tog sna tshogs byin pas dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 37yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /rta dang / glang po che dang /shing rta byin pas rgyas pa dang / yangs pa dang che ba phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 41wa 145

'thob bo/ /skyed mos tshal dang / dka' thub kyi nags tshal byin pas bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa 17yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa (kyerab tu 'thob bo/ /nor dang ske/ 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang ba byin pas chos rin po che thams cad kyi mdzod yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /bran pho dang ske/ bran mo dang / las byed pa'i mi byin pas rang nyam dang / rang dbang dang / rang byung gi ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /bu pho dang / bu mo byin pas mdza' ba dang / sdug pa dang /'dod pa'i ci bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /gling bzhi'i⑧rgyal po'i longs spyod thams cad byin pas byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob ste/ shā ri'i bu phan yon ri bcu po de dag yongs su gzung bar 'gyur royi/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' byang chub 'dod pas (7de ltar sbyin pa byin na phan yon ⑧gzhan yang bcu 'thob bo/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga byin pas tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yongs su dag pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /dga' ba'i rtsed mo ⑨thams cad yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin 〉pas dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ba dang / rtse ba yongs su dag pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /rkang pa byin pas nyu1chos kyi don gyi rkang pa byang chub kyi hu snying por 'gro ba nyi yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob 41wa 146

bo/ /lag pa byin pas sems can thams cad la chos kyi lag pa rab tu sbyinanyepa yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /rna ba dang / sna byin pas dbang po ma tshang ba med cing yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /yan lag dang nying lag byin pas kha na ma tho ba med cing mdzes pa'i yan lag sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /mig byin pas sems can thams cad la chos kyi mig mi sgribalgepa yongs su dag pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /sha dang khrag byin pas sems can thams cad kyi lus dang srogasasnying po med pa las snying po len pas nye bar 'tsho ba la mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /rkang7byin pas rdo rje ltar mi shigs pa'i lus 'thob pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /yan lag gi dam pa mgo byin pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gsum0gyi mchog bla na med cing ltag na med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa nyeyongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thob ste/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' byang chub 'dod pas de ltar sbyin pa byin na 'di lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i phan yon ⑧de dag yongs su gzung bar 'gyur phro/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ⑩mkhas pa zab pa shes rab kyi snang ba ni7'jig rten gyi zang zing gis7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod(rte/ bdud rtsi 'dodabu/ snying po 'dod8/ byang chub 'dod de⑩/ 7yang shā ri'i bu mya ngan las 'das pa 'dod pa ni 8bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas te/ 'jig rten gyi zang zing sbyin pa na 'jig rten gyi bde ba thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba gang yang 41—147

med do/ /'di lta ste/ shā ri'i bu khyim bdag chun pa zhing skamasatul gnas nas ba lang rinadang / gnam sdong ma yin pa'i bzhing gi rmo brko rdzogs par byasashete / sa bon btab nas rnam grangs 'dis5ge)gshol gyis 'tsho bsalgegaser dang /dngul yang 'grub bo/ /dngos po sna tshogs gzhan yang 'grub bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'bru dang mtshungs pa'i nor med do/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar7'jig rten gyi zang zing la gnas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par ⑧'tshang rgya bar 'gyur nyu)ba'i dus dang tshod 7yod do/ /'di lta ste/ shā ri'i bu bas rtswa nyu1skam po nyurtedang / gsher ba zos pa dang / chu grang mo5)dang / dron mo la'athungs pa de las 'o ma 'grub ste/ zho dang / mar sar pa 8dang / mar gyi snying po yang 'grub bo/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas te/'jig rten gyi zang zing sbyin ⑩pa 3 na/ de mi 'dod kyang 'khor los sgyur〈nyeba'i rgyal po yang yongs su 'grub bo/ /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa yang 'grub bo / /gnas de gsum yongs su grub nas byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu yongs su 'grub bo/ /de bzhin 37gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi yang yongs su 'grub bo/ /las stong gis 'grub sa )pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad rnams kyang yongs su 'grub bo/ /las stong gis 'gruba' spepa'i rnam pa drug cu 2dang ldan pa'i dbyangs phun sum tshogs pa yang yongs su 'grub bo/ /las brgyas 'grub shrī snyepa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gcig yongs su 'grub bo/ /las nyis brgyas 'grub sku 0pa'i gtsug tor spyi bor 'grub bo/ /rnam 41wa 148

pa dang yon tan brgyas yongs su rdzogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dung chen po yang 'grub bo/ /rnam pa bye ba dang / yon tan brgya0)phrag stong dang ldan pa'i tshems kyi phreng ba ②thags bzang ba / phrag med pa snyomasasnyishing dkar5de ba yang yongs su 'grub ste/ de ltar shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pas mngon par 'grub bo/ /yang shā ri'i bu gang byams pa'i sems bskyed nas geslong ba la sbyin pa byin pa de ni gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sems bskyed pas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge ⑦'dzin rgyun mi 'chad pa gcig 'grub ste/ ting nge 'dzin de shel gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas7ba spu'i bu ga re re nas ting nge 'dzin brgya ( 7gang gā'i rgyun ltar mngon par sprul pa mdzad de1te/shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba thams cad la dbang thob pa'o / /shā ri'i bu gang tso'adi lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa sngon byang chub sems dpa'i 4)spyad pa spyod pa na 'jig rten gyi zang zing gi sbyin pas yongs su bzung rnyib yin no/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' mi 'chi ba 3)'dod pa dang / byang chub 'dod pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa 8'dod pa ni 'jig rten gyi zang zing sbyin par byed do/ /shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi zang zing la gnas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chubatshwa snamangon par rdzogs par tso'atshang rgya bar rig par gyis shig /shā ri'i bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa grangs med pa shin tu grangs med pa tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa gang byung ba de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 41—149

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos mos ①zhes bya ba/ rig pa dang zhabs su ②ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyurasheb bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ngo / /yang shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos mos kyikyiche'i tshad ni lo stong phrag bcur gyur to/ /yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa chos mosasnyide'i dge slong stong phrag brgyakyini dgra bcom pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par ⑨gyur pa nas/sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi ⑧dam pa'i ⑨pa rol tu son tho )pa'i bar du ste/dgra bcom pa /1sha stag gike'adus pa chen po byung ngoshe/ /shā ri'i bu de'i tshe tha ga pa zhes bya ba thags 'thag pa/ gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ bltacan sdug pa/ mdog bzang zhing rgyas pa'i mchogatshwanyedang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ de de bzhin gshegs pa chos mosalgegang na bzhugs〈nyepa'i sa phyogs de nas ha7cang yang0)mi ring ba'i sa phyogs zhig ste na rang gi las byed do/ /de nyin par las byas nas nub kur khyim du 'gro ba'i tshe rtag tu dus thams cad du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos mos5 tede'i drung du 'ongs nas ras kyi kha tshar gcig 'bul cing 3ge'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bsdu ba'i gnas kyis5༄bdag bcom ldan 'das la5 nye ras kyi kha tshar phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bsdu ba thams cad dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces des rim gyis — ras kyi kha tshar stong lnga brgya phul te/ des bskal pa bye ba phrag bco lngar ngan 'gro log par ltung (7bar ma song ngo / /dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid 41—150

kyis 'khor los sgyuratuba'i rgyal po bye ba phrag stong myong ngo / /de dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis brgyasabyin gyisabadag po bye ba phrag stong myong ngo / /dge ba'i rtsa bshe'ajam pa7yid du 'ong ba dang po pa'i las de nyid kyisakyisangs rgyas bye ba phrag stong mnyes par byas te/ des thams cad la me tog dang / bdug pa dang /sposashedang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos dang / zhal zas dang / mal chaphudang / na ba'i gsosashesman dang / yo byad kyis bste stang du byas / bla mar byas/ ri mor byas nasalgemachod do/ /de phyis bskal pa grangs med pa zhig na bla na med pa yang dag par byang chub mngon par rdzogs paratsosangs rgyas nas/ rab tu bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de lo bye ba phrag nyi shu'i bar du gnas so/ /de'i dgra bcom pa7bye ba khrag khrig phrag nyi shutswazag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par7gyur pa nas/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa'i bar gyi nyan thos 'dus pa chen po byung ngo7/ /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag lnga yang7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bkod do/ /des chos bstan te sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa'i don byas nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /der bcom ldan 'das de nyeyongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo stong gi bar du dam pa'i chos gnas so/ /de'i sku gdung yang rgyas par gyur te.e/ 'di lta ste/ dper na shā ri'i bu nga dke yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba 41—151

bzhin no/ /shā ri'i bu ras kyi7kha tshar phul ba dang / sems bskyed pas kyang mthar gyis sangs rgyas kyi〈 chos yongs su rdzogs pa la ltos/ shā ri'i bu sems ni rgya che ba'i sbyin pasani ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bu gal te sbyin pa rgya che la sems kyis ma yin na ni sbyin bdag rtsub mo zhes bya ba ltar 'gyur te/ des sbyin pa de snyed byin yang sems yongs su ma sbyangs so/ /shā ri'i bu 'jig rten gyi zang zing la gnas te/ thams cad yongs su thob par gyur pa la ltos/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ni sbyin pa nyung ngu ④yang mang por byed doge/ /ye shes kyi stobs kyis lhag par byed dozhu/ /shes rab kyi stobs kyis rgyas par byed dog / /bsngo ba'i stobs kyis dpag tu med par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de nyid rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /gzugs 'dod phyir ni sbyin pa sbyin mi byedage/ /longs spyod mtho ris 'dod phyir ma yin gyi/ /bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas mchog 'dod phyir / /de phyir sbyin pa chung yang du mar 1)'gyur/ /grags dang brjod pa dag dang sgra dag dang / /g.yog dang bde ba nam yang mi 'dod cing / /'chi 'pho skye ba kun kyang mi 'dod denyu) / /de phyir sbyin nyung 3nya'abras bu chen por 'gyur/ /zas dang skom dang chos gos gang sbyin hu pa/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba 'dod phyir ma yin te/ /sbyin pas 'chi ba med pa'i sgo btsal phyir/ /derwa ni skra rtse tsam yang sbyin pa sbyin/ /'phyar lib med cing khengs dpa med par 'gyur/ /g.yo dang ser sna dag ni thams cad spong / /de dag le lo nam yang yod min te/ de ltar de dag 'jig rten phan phyir spro/ /rgyal po'i srid tsodang 7nor dang 'bru srog gtong / /de dag sems ni gzhan du mi 'gyur te/ /byin nas dga' ba 41—152

chen po rnyed par 'gyur/ /sbyin zhing gtong la byang chub rnyed mi dka'/ /pha dang ma dang bu ni sdug patultar/ / slong dang 'jig rten kun la de bzhin te/ /gang gis byang chub spyod mchog spyad pa rnams/ /sbyin tshe rtag tu phrag dog med par 'gyurage/ /de dag mthong na mi khro steg/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bzhin du smra/ /mi mdza' dag dang rtag mdza' zhing / /skrag pa rnams la 'jigasasnyimed sbyina')/ /de la dngos po gang yod pa/ /slong ba la ni sri ba med/ /chos 'dod par57ni rtag 'gyur te/ /rgyal sridakyi'adod par mi 'gyur ro/ /'byung bar rtag tu smra byed cing / /chos kyi sbyin pa 'ang sbyin par byedani/ /'dod la brkam57pa ma gtogs par/ /su zhig rgyal srid hu) 'dod par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i rgyal sridarwalhami 'dod cing / /mtho ris bde ba 'dod ma yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yongs tshol zhing / /grags pa chen po sbyin pa sbyin12/ /bdag dang nor rdzas gzhan dag kyang7)/ /mang po myur du gtong ba ni/ /de dag byang chub dam pa'isamachog / nam yangashigatong bar mi 'gyur rol/ /mkhas pa gzugs ni mi 'dod de'i/ /longs spyod dag kyang 'dod ma yin/ /mtho ris dag kyang de mi 'dod / /mya ngan 'da' ba'ang 'dod ma yin/ /lam shes lam la mkhas pa dag /gang dag hu)bshes par gyur pa la/ /brten 1)pa dag tu mi byed de/ / srid pa med pa 'dod par 'gyuradu 3/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dag (nyabyang chub kyi spyad pa spyod 32do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //41—153

①bam po dag⑧pa/ de la gang la brtson pas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod par 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di gsum ni/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gelegs par spyod pa ste④/ gsum gang zhe na/lus kyis legs par spyod pa dang / ngag gis legs par spyod pa dang / yid kyis legs par spyod pa'o⑤/ /de la lus kyis legs par spyod pa gang zhe na/'di la shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni/ srog gcod pa spangs pa yin/ma byin par len pa spangs pa yin/ 'dod pa lashelog par g.yem pa spangs pa yin te/ 'di ni lus kyis legs par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub semasasnyedapa' ni/ brdzun du smra ba spangs pa yin/ phra ma dang ngag rtsub po dang / tshig kyal pa7spangs pa yin te/ 'di ni ngag gis legs par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni/ brnab sems med/ gnod sems med cing / yang dag par lta ba yin te/ 'di ni yid kyis legs par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ lus kyis legs par spyod pa gang / ngag gis legs par spyod pa gang / yid kyisalgelegs par spyod pa gang7yin snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam du sems te/ lus kyi tsho/rtelas gang / srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par 8len pa dang / 'dod pa la7log par g.yem pasam byas pa de ni/ lus kyis legs par spyod pa zhes bya'orwa)snyam mo/ /de la ngag gis legs par spyod pa gang zhe na/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ ngag gi5nyelas gang brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / ngag rtsub porwa/dang / tshig kyal pa du )ma smras pa de ni/ ngag gis legs par spyod pa zhes 41—154

bya'o snyam mo/ /de la yid kyis legs par spyod pa gang zhe na/ denye'adi snyam du sems te/ yid kyishelas gang / brnabashesems dang / gnod sems dang /log par lta ba ma byas pa de ni yid kyis legs par spyod pa zhes bya'o snyam mo/ /de 'di ltar tshul bzhin so sor rtog stetsho/ las gang lus kyis ma byas pa dang /las gang ngag dang / yid kyis ma byas pa de ci gdags par nus sam/ de 'di ltar tshul bzhin gyis/ rtog pa na 'di snyam du sems te/ las gang lus kyis ma byas pa dang / las gang ngag dang yid kyis ma byas pa de sngon po 'am/ser po 'am/ dmar po 'am/ dkar po 'am/ leb rgan nam/ shel gyi kha dog tu gdags par mi nus te/ mig gis shes par bya ba ma yin⑦/ rna bas shes par bya ba ma yin/ snas shes par bya ba ma yin/ lces shes par bya ba ma yin/ lus kyis shes par bya ba ma yin/ yid kyis shes par bya ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni skyes pa ma yin/ bskyed pa ma yin/ byung ba ma yin/ zin⑧pa ma yin te/ de ni las gang gis kyang shes par bya ba ma yin no/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ tshul khrims de ni/ gang mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /gang mngon par 'du mi byed pa de la gdags pa gang0)yang med do/ /gang gdags pa med pa/ de la bdag mngon par chags par mi bya'o snyam nas/ de 'di ltar legs par spyad pa'i tshul khrims kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / gang gi tshul khrims de dang / tshul khrims de gang du bsngo ba/ de yang yang5)dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de de ltar mthong bas/'jig 'itshogs la lta ba gang gis(nye/ tshul khrims sam/ 'chal pa'i༄tshul khrimasasnyil/ so sor rtog par 'gyur ba'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba mi slong ngo / /41—155

de de ltar mthong bas sdom hu)pa dang / cho ga dang / spyod pa dang / spyod yulasheshes bzhin du spyod par 'gyur te / shes bzhin du spyod pas tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /de bdag tu dmigs shing mi spyod/ pha rol tu dmigs shing mi spyod de/ de tshul khrims ma nyams pa dang / tshul khrims mchog tu mi 'dzin byupa yin no/ /bdag tu dmigs na tshul khrims su dmigs par 'gyur gyi/gang bdag tu mi ge)dmigs pa de ni tshul khrims su mi dmigs sotsho/ /gang tshul khrims su mi dmigs pa de ni bslab pa nyams par mi byed do/ /gang slab pa nyams par mi byed pa de tshul khrims nyams par mi byed de/ tshul khrims mchog tu mi 'dzin to/ /ci'i phyir mchog tu mi 'dzin ce5nyen/ des gzhan las chos thams cad shes so/ /(r+sha gzhan gang yin tshipa de la bdag med do/ /gang bdag med pa de la ci zhig yongs su gzung bar 37bya/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /lus kyis dag cing ngag gis dag pa dang / /yid kyis dag cing rtag tu spyod pa dag /dag pa'i brtul zhugs la ni rtag gnas pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims ldan/ /shin tu bzang po'i las lam bcu po 'di/ /gang dag srung hurteb byang chub sems dpa' mkhas/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis gang ma byas/ /de ni mkhas pa tshul khrims ldan zhes bya/ /gang dag ma byas ma bskyed mi len pa/ /de la kha dog med cing dbyibs kyang med/ /gang la kha dog med cing dbyibs med pa/ /de la gdags pa nam yang 1 mi dmigs so/ /rtag tu tshul khrims ma byas 'dus ma byas/ /de ni mig gis blta bar mi nus teyi/ /rna ba sna dang lce yis7shes ma yin/ /lus dang yid kyis shes par bya ma yin/ /gang de dbang pos shes 41—156

par mi nus pa/ /de la snying rje 'jug pa7nus ma yin/ /de ltar tshul khrims yangasnyedag mthong ba de / /nam yang tshul khrims dmigs par mi gnas so/ /tshul khrims ldan zhes yid kyis mi snyems shing / /bdag tu 'dzin pasalatshul khrims mi srung stetsho/ /tshul khrims srung56)yang tshul khrims 'du shes med/ /de ni khrims ldan byang chub spyad spyod pa(pe/ /'jig tshogs la ni lta ba gang sel ba/ /de ni ltasnyibar nam du'ang mi 'gyur ro/ /gang la lta med de la gnas med de/ /tshul khrims 'chal dang tshul khrims7de mi snyems/ /chos kyi tshul la 'jug pa kun srung ba/ /de yi cho ga bsam du med par 'gyur/ /rab tu 'byung zhing rab tu bsrungs hu7pa ni/ /tshul khrims ldan te hurtegazhan la rtsod mi byedage/ /bdag med 'du shes tshul khrims mi dmigs tetunye/ /tsobadag med de la tshul khrims dmigs pa'ang med/ /bdag dang de bzhin tshul khrims gang snyems pa/ /rtag tu 'jig pa'i mtha' zhes ngas bshad dos/ /bdag med smra ba tshul khrims mi sems te/ /bdag med smra ba tshul khrims gnas ma yin/ /bdag med smra ba tshul khrims mi sems te/ /bdag med smra ba tshul khrims rtog ma yin/ /tshul khrims ma nyams tshul khrims skyon med pa/ /bdag ni tshul khrims ldan zhes mi slong ngo / /bdag snyel bdag med tshul khrims 'du shes med/ /shes rab zab mo byang chub spyad pa spyod/ /'jigs med gang dag tshul khrims 'di 'dra ba/ /nam yang tshul khrims 'chal pararwanyede mi 'gyur/ /thams cad chos ni gang dag mi dmigs pa/ / de yilo )tshul khrims de ni 'phags pas bsngags/ /byis pa〈 nyagang dag bdag tu lta gnas te/ /bdag ni tshul khrims ldan zhes khrims srung〈rtezhing ske/ /bsrungs nas mtshul khrims 'bras bu myong ba denihe/ /ngan 'gro gsum po 41—157

kun las mi thar to/ /gang dag bdag tu lta ba kun spangs pa/ /de ni nga dang nga zhes bya mi 'byungatu/ /tshul khrims ldan pa de la lta med de②/ /de ni phyir yangasalog ltung mi 'jigs so/ /'di 'dra ba yi tshul khrims gang shes pa/ /de la 'chal ④pa'i tshul khrims blta mi nus/ /srid pa gsum na de bdag mi mthong na / / khrims dang tshul 'chal mthong 'gyur smos ci dgosargya/ /shā ri'i bu de ltar tshul khrims spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa'i ⑤chos bcu 'dus par 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ dad pa'i bsam pa 'dus par 'gyur ba dang ske/ brtson 'grus kyi bsam pa 'dus par 'gyur ba dang / rab tu 'dunashepa dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa rgya chen po la dad pa dang / 'phags pa la ldang ba byed pa dang / bla ma la rim gro byed pa dang / slobasngo)dpon la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos tshol ba la 'jug〈nyepar byed pa dang / byang chub yongs su tshol7zhing lus dang srog la mi lta bar byed pa ste/ shā ri'i bu de ltar tshul khrims spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa chos bcu po de dag 'dus par 'gyur ro/ /de chos bcu po 8de dag la rab tu gnas nas dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par 8sgrub tsobo/ /dge ba'i chos gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / legs par spyod pa gsum po 'di dag nyid de 7lus dang ngag dang yid kyis legs par spyod pa'o/ /legs par spyod pa gsum po de dag la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni de'i〈nyebyang chub gang dang 'brel hurtepa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sde ( nye snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yongs sumanyetshol lo/ /'di༄nyel de'i chos nyid ni 'di yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dag gis bsngags pa yi/ /dge ba'i las rnams lus kyis byengasanye/ /41—158

gang las thos pa hu)rnyed 'gyur ba'i/ /slob dpon la yangalon/rim gro byed/ /sems can thams cad don gyi phyir/ /byams pa'i sems ldan 0phrag dog med/ /chos las brtsams teṣ+ṭha)gang zag la/ / ri mo cir/dag ni rab tu byed/ /ngag ni shin tu sdom gyur te6)/ /de ni mi snyan tshig mi smra/ / 'di ni 'dun dang ldan pa'i mtshan57)/ /nam du'ang ngag rtsub mi smra'o/ /yid ni dge ba'i yid du 'gyur 2)ske/ /nam du'ang sdig pa mi 'dod do1/ /byams sems gus dang bcas pa yi/ / bsam pa nyid kyis 7rtag tu lta317/ /rgyal bas bstan pa thos gyur nas//chos 'di la ni 12gus dang bcas/ /chos la 3)gus par byas pas na/ /myur du byang chub rnam 'tshang rgya/ /chos bcu po de dag la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub besems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa'i77sde snod kyi chos yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang 7bsnyen bkur tho byed de/ tha na chu rdza 38gang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu 37byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed pa bcu bskyed de/ — ri/ bcu gang zhe na/ kye ma'o lus 'di ni na ba ste nya/ khams ni ni sbrul gdug pa bzhin du rtag par zhugephan tshun mi 'phrod pa'o ‘/ /sdug bsngal mang ba'o / /nyes pa mang ba'o/ /smyo ba dang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang /me dbal dgedang / g.yan pa dang / rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kun gyis 39gang ste/ nad dang 'dra/ phol mig 2 dang 'dra/ zug rngu dang 'dra/chu bo dang 'dra/ gnod pa dang 'dra/ g.yo ba/ 'jig pa/ snying po med pa/nyam chung ba/ shig shig po/ yun thung ba snye/ skad cig pa/ dur khrod du 'jig pa ste/ snying po med pas rmo 6lus las snying po blang ngo snyamasko du sems bskyed pa dang po de bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 41—159

yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang nya1/ bsnyen bkuratsha byed de/ tha na chu por cigang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs te ri / bde bar gshegs pas de skad bka' stsal nas ston pasngon/yang 'di skad gsung snyodango / /khams ni sbrulas nogadug ma rung 58)pa/ /bzhi po gcig la gcig brten 9 te/ /re re yang ni 'khrugs pa las/ /nad po che choni 'byung bar 'gyur / /mig nad dang ni rna nad dang / /sna nad dang ni de bzhin du/ /so nad dang ni mchu nad rnams/ /gzhan yang lus las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /smyo dang 'bras dang phol mig dang / /me dbal nya1g.yan pa rnams dang ni/ /nad gzhan rnam pa mang po dag /lus las su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lus 'di nad dang mtshungs pa nyugeste/ /lus ni 'brum bu 'dra ba'o/ /lus 'di gnod pa 'dra ba ste/ / yun thung skad cig 'dus pa'o32/ /dur khrod du ni 'gro zhing 'jig /mi rtag mi brtan g.yo ba ste/ / rab tu 'jig cing na ba dang / /lus 'di rnag gis gang ba stes/ /8shig sgog po dang yun thung btso/ /rnag gis gang ba'i lus 'di yis/ / sangs rgyas kyi ni sku yi phyir/ /dge ba'i las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /7thams cad du ni rab zag pa/ /rnag gis gang ba'i lus 'di yis/ /chos sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sku 'grubatshwa bo/ /gang na gzhan gyis thob nyugemed pa/ /de 'dra'i lus ni thob par bya/ /tsha ba dag kyang gang sgrib dang / /bsil ba dag kyang rab srung tri stab/ /lus 'di yang ni dga' 2stob dang / /'chi ba dag gis gzhom par da 'gyur/ /gang dag grang dang tsha bzod pa/ /lus kyis su na ni thams cad du/ /skyes bu'i bya ba byed pa yis ske/ /mchog gi lus ni thob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten grags pa'i bla ma la/ /41wa 160

rim gro dag ni rab bya ste7)/ /snying po med pa'i lus las su/ /snying po dag ni blang bar ②'gyur/ /shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa dang po 'di bskyed nas gebyang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yongs su tshol bas slob dpon lasnyi rim gro dang /sri bsnyen bkur ne byed ri de/ tha na chu rdzasagang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed de/ kye ma'o lus 'di ni snying po med pa ste/ rtag tu drilasheb dang / bkru ba dang / mnye ba dang / 'jig pa dang / 'gyes pa dang ske/ 'bral7ba'i chos can no/ / shā ri'i bu 31'di lta ste/ dper na 32ji tsam du rdza mkhan gyis5)bum pa chung tshad dang / che tshad byas pa thams cad kyang mthar 'jig go/ /de bzhin du kye ma'o lus 'di yang snying po med pa 7so ma btang snyiba'i snod bzhin te/ mthar 'jig pa'o/ / shā ri'i bu 7'di lta ste/ dper na yishing gi yal ga'i 'dab ma dang / me 3 tog dang / 'bras bu ji snyed pa de thams cad kyang mthar nyung bar 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du kye ma'o lus 'di ni (7snying po med de/ 'bras bu smin pa bzhin du ltung ba'i chos can no(nye ske/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ltamanyaste/ dper na rtswa'i tsho ci rtse mo'i zil pa'i thigs lhapa ji snyed pa de thams cad kyang nyi mas phog na ring por mi gnas so/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du kye ma'o lus 'di ni snying po med pa ste/ zil pa'i thigs 34pa bzhin du ring por mi gnas pa'o/ / shā ri'i bu 25'di lta ste/ dper na nilhargya mtsho chen po dang / 'bab chu dang / 'bab chu'i rgyun la dbu 3 tshob rdos pa yod pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang snying po med de rang bzhin gyis nyam chung ba'o/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du kye ma'o lus 'di ni snying po med pa ste/ dbu dzo snyeb rdos pa 41wa 161

ltar rang bzhin gyis nyam chung ba'o/ / shā ri'i bu 1'di lta ste/ dper napochar bab pa'i chu'i chu bur gzhan skye zhing gzhan 'gag go/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du kye ma'o lus 'di ni snying po med pa ste/ chu'i chu bur ltar rang bzhin gyis 4nyam chung ba'o/ /de 5ltar snying po med pa'i lus las snying po blang ngo snyam du sems bskyed pa gnyis pa de bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' ne/byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam 7grangs yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang 8bsnyen bkur 9byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de nyid rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ de'i 1 tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /ji ltar rdza ma'i mkhan po yis/ /sa la nyurtasnod rnams byas pa dag /de dag thams cad mthar 'jig ste/ /sems can srog kyang de dang 'dra3ge/ /ji ltar shing gi yal ga yi/lha/ /lo ma me mitog 'bras bu rnams/ /thams cad ltung ba'i chos can te/ /mi yisangasrog kyang de bzhin no/ /rtswa tshemachog dag gi zil pa'i thigs/ /nyi mas 1 yongs su bab pa na/ /yid 38tsam gyis ni med 'gyur te/ / mi yi 19slog kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'bab chu'i rgyun rnams kyi / /dbu rdu ba rdos pa nyam chung ltar 1/ /de ltar lus ni nyam chung ste/ /snying po med pa dbu 22ba 'dra/ /ji ltar char pa bab pa yig —rte/ / chu yi 39chu bur skyes pa yang / /skad cig gis du ni de 'jig 'gyur/ /de bzhin lus kyang snying po med / /snying po ma yin snying por shes/ /snying po snying po ma yin 'dzin su/ /de dag log rtog spyod yul te/ /snying po khong du chud ma yin/ /snying po med la snying med pa / /snying po snying por shes pa ni/ /de dag yang dag rtog pa'i 28yul / /snying po khong du chud pa yin/ /snying po 38'du shes byas gyur te/ /rdzas ri41—162

gang tsam gyi chu 'bul ba/ /snying po med pa'i lus las ni/ /snying po dag ni len par 'gyur/ /shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa gnyis pa 'di bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' 1)byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yongs su tshol bas ri slob dpon la rim gro dang ༷/ bsnyen bkur gibyed de/ tha na chu phor gegang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed de/ bdag yun ring por dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral zhing mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang du song ste/ le lo can/ brtson 'grus nyams pa/ snyom las 6)can/ blun pa7/ log par lta ba ste/ mchod sbyin yang med/ sbyin sreg 2)kyang med/ legs byas dang / nyes byas kyi las rnams byas pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa bsags 9pa yang med par lta ba dang /'dod pa'i zil gyis non te/ bdag gis mi dge ba'i las mang po mngon par 'dus byas te/ mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa des 'di lta ste/ yi7 dgas kyi 711yul du 7sbyin gnas thams cad gso nya ba ma yin pa 'jigs su rung ba'i lus thob ste/ 'di lta bu'i sbyin gnas mnyes par 1 ma byas pas de ni nyanabadag yi dgas su gyur te/ lo mang po/ lo stong phrag mang po/ lo brgya stong phrag mang por me mas mur za zhing chu'i sgra yang mi thos na/ lus kyi nya lta ga la zhig reg ste/ bdag gis ni da ltar mnyes par 38byas pas bdag dge ba'i lus thob kyis nyi)sbyin gnas thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho bar 2 bya zhing / lus dang srog la mi lta bar byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam 1grangs yongs su btsal ba'i phyir 32slob dpon la rim gro 2nyebya'o snyam du sems bskyed pa gsum pa 'di dag 24bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la rim gro dang 2snye/41wa 163

bsnyen bkur byed de/nyu1 tha na chu rdza rigang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /ji ltar grogs po bsten pa dang / /ji ltar nye bar bston gapa ltar/ /de dag yang dang yang bsnyen pas/ /de yang de dang 'dra bar (ri)'gyur/ /sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang song nas/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 55)rnam par spangs/ /le lo che zhing〈gebartson 'grus nyams/ /g.yo rimadang phrag dog ser sna can/ /byis ni)pa yod par gang lta ba / /thams cad du ni rnam spangs pasatshe/ /bdag ni yi dgas skye gnas su/ /'jigs su rung ba'i lus thob bo/ /yun ring dus sum/nya'akhor ba yi/ /mun nag phung po 'jigs pa na/2/ /bkres pa dang ni skom pas gzir/ /sdug bsngal mang po rjes su myong / /sbyin gnas rnams ni ma mthong zhing / /bdag gis 'di 'dra /snyedal ma thob/ /lo ni mang po stong rnams su/ / chu yi 0sgra yang yong /lham thos/ /da ltar bdag gis tsha'ajig rten na/ /shin tu dkon pa rab rnyed de/ /bdag gis slob dpon mnyes byas pas / rme/ /dal ba 'byor pa bdag gis thob/ /sdig pa'i grogs po rnam spangs pas/ /bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen 1/rnyed/ /byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /lus dang srog la mi blta'oḥzhe//sangs rgyas kyi ni byang chub phyir/ /slob dpon 3 7bla ma mchod gnas 31/la/ / rnam par 22dad pa'i sems kyis suni// /bsti stang gus par rab tu du stebya/ /shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa gsum pa 25'di bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang —4/ bsnyen bkur smyo byed de/ tha na chu phor 3)gang tsam yang 'bul lo / /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed de/41wa 164

bdag yun ring por dge ba'i bshes gnyen0)dang bral zhing sdig pa'i grogs pos zinaro0pas le lo can/ brtson 'grus nyams pa/ snyom las57can/ blun pas casems can la khu tshur dang / thal mos brdegs shing gtses nas bsdus shing cho nge btonasate/ de'i gzhi las sdig pa yang med/ de'i gzhi las sdig pa 'byung ne ba yang med do/ /zhes de ltar lta ba dang / de ltar bzod pa dang / de ltar mos shing zhe sdang gi zil gyis non pas (1)mi dge ba'i las rnams mngon par 'dus byas te/ mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa des 'di lta ste dud 'gro'i rin skye'uganas su/ sbyin gnas thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba ma yin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i lus thob ste/ 'di lta bu'i sbyin gnas mgu bar tshim byas pas/ des kyi na bdag rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong bur gyur te/ rtswasngo za zhing dbyig nyusnyepas bsdigasabya/ 'jigs pas bsdigs nas/ mi 'dodatshwanyebazhin du khal bkal toyi / /bdag gis ni da ltar mnyes par byas te/ dag pa'i 3 snalus thob kyis08lus dang srog la mi blta 37bar slob dpon la ni rim gro dang 3 / bsnyen bkur 31bya'o zhes rte/ shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa bzhi pa tsho rtede bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la rim gro dang du stebasnyen bkur ninyebyed de nya/ tha na chu bum pa 3 tshogang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /'di'i du /chos nyid ni 'di yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /yun ring por ni 'phags pa'i lam/ /ma rig par nim/gnas pas na/ /rnga mo dag dang duX bong bur gyur/ /sdug bsngal mang po ༄7rjes su myong ske/ /mirang gyur pa5)yang bdag gis rnyed/ /gangs gis byang chub reg 'gyur ba'i/ /bzang po yi ni las bya stoge/ /de ni mkhas pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sangs rgyas chos lamugarab gnas shing / /gus pa dang ni ldan par bya( tsho/ /byang 41wa 165

chub phyir ni slob dpon la/ /rim gro dang ni bste stang bya/ /'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa bsam 1med nas/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lor yongs su 'khyamasam pa na/ /skye mched dag ni don med 'das gyur techos/ /sbyin gnas dag ni nye bar 'tsho ba min ske/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyeyongs su spangs gyur nas/ /rtag tu sdig pa'i grogs po rab bsten te/ /de dag gis 6)ni bstan pa'i rjes 'jug cing / / rgyun mi 'chad par dzongan song sa la gnas/ / gtse ba 50dang ni bcing zhing brdeg 9pa rnams/ /byed du bcug cing khogazhan la spyos 11byas nas/ / de yi72'bras bu ngan song skye gnas 'gro/ /sdig pa'i las kyis sdug bsngal rjes su myong //dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni ma bsten pas/ /rnga mo ba lang de bzhin bong bu yi / /ngan pa'i mtshams kyi skye mched bzung 1 gyur nas/ /dbyug pa dag gis brdegs shing khal kyang bkal/ / mir 'gyur ba ni nyu )shin tu rnyed yidaka' ⑩dang ske/ /'thun pa'i yul dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed3 / /nyu shin tu yun ring dal ba rnyed gyur te/ /dka' ba'i las kyi bu gar chud pa bzhin1ce/ /lus dang ngag ni 5 shin tu bsdams gyur nas/ / 1zhen pa med pa'i sems kyis du2brtson 'grus da brtsamasanu trī/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag la g.yo med pas/ /py-i snyebadag gi lus ni nye bar 'tsho 27bar bya/ /bdag gi slob dpon bla ma gang dag dang glu/ /gang dag bdag gi byang chub sems bskyed pas / /byang chub dam pa mchog gi lam ston lari she/ /ston pa bzhin du dga' bas bsnyen bkur bya/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dag gi na byug pa dang / /dri dang phye ma rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /gos dang me tog dag gi chun po yis/ /rkang gnyis dam pa la ni mchod par bya/ /phyogs bcu dag na sangs rgyas gang bzhugs pa/ /sems can don la brtson zhing 41wa 166

don dam gzigasadzo)/ /gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od mdzes〈lde)pa/ /kha dog mtha' yas pa la mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas mi yi kha lo sgyur ri rnams la/ /'jig rten spyod dang mchod pa cher 44)byas pas/ /gang gis byang chub snying por bdag 'gro ba'i/ /byang chub lam ni shin tu sbyangs paras48)'gyur/ /shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa bzhi pa ye'adi bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang 3)/ bsnyen bkur〈byed te/de/ tha na chu bum pa 7gang tsam yang 'bul lo31 / /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed de/bdag yun ring por dge ba'i bshes7sheganyen dang bral zhing sdig pa'i grogs pos zin pa(nya/ le lo can/ brtson 'grus nyams pa/ snyom lasapha can/ blun pas / 'di lta bu'i lta ba dang / 'di lta bu'i 'dod pas sems can thams cad dang / srog chags thams cad kyi sha gcig tu spungs shing sha gcig tu bcerardzogete/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i las byed kyang / de'i gzhi las sdig pa med / de'i gzhi las sdig pa'i rnam pa med do/ /rgya mcho1re tshu rol gyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad sbyin pas tshim par byas kyang / de'i gzhi las bsod nams med/ de'i gzhi las bsod nams kyi rnam pa med do/ /rgya mchoXre pha rol gyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bsad cing gtub 8kyang de'i gzhi las sdig pa med/ de'i gzhi las sdig pa'i rnam pa med do snyam pas derwa snaltar byas kyang bsod nams dang sdig pa yongs su shes par ma nus te/ sdig pa'i lta ba bsnyen pa dang / gti mug gatshwa zil gyis non pas bdag gis sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mang po mngon par 'dus byas te/ mi dge ba'i 17las de'i 41—167

rnam par smin pasamanya)'di lta ste/ sems can dmyal bar dmanadzasapa 'jigs su rung ba'i lus thob ste/ de la 'di lta bu'i sbyin gnas mnyes par 55)ma byas pas des na bdag ni cho5)sems can dmyal ba par 56)gyur pas lcags mekyi thu lum bsregs pa za zhing gcig tu sdug bsngal ba rtsub pa/ mi bzad pa/ 'tshogs du pa / 'chi ba'i mthar khrid pa myong zhing lo stong phrag mang po'i bar du bde ba'i sgra yang mi thos na/ lus kyis lta ga la zhig reg 49)ste/ bdag gis ni da ltar mnyes par mabyas /1pas/ dge ba'i lus thob kyisahunye/ sbyin gnas rnams kyi nye bar 'tsho bar lha bya zhing lus dang srog la mi lta bar slob dpon la rim gro dngatso/bsnyen bkur mibya'o zhes / shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa lnga pa de bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur byed de/ tha na chu bum pa gang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /sdig pa'i grogs po bsnyen pa dang / /sdig pa'i sems kyis bslus pas na/ /sdig par 8lta la bsten gyur tehunye/ /bdag gis sdig pa'i las byas so/ /rgya mtsho yi /tsheni tshu rol na/ /sems can gnas pa ji snyed pa/ /zas dang skom gyis tshim byas kyang / /bsod nams dag gi tsho — 'byung gnas med/ /rgya mtsho yi ni ni pha rol na/ /sems can gnas pa ji snyed pa / /thams cad bsad ri 2cing bcom gyur kyang / /sdig pa'i 'byung gnas med do zhes/ /sdig par shrī 2lta ba 'di lta bu/ /yang dang yang du bsten pas na/ /gcig tu mi bzad ma rungs pa'i/ /sems can dmyal bar ring du dengs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi/ /yongs su 'dren pa༄stem mthong bas/ /41wa 168

bdag gi lus ni stong rnams kyang / /ngan 'gro dag ni gsum du dengs/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba ste/ / de yi (11sgra ni thos gyur nas/ /bdag gis mi yi risadangos thob kyis / /bzang po yi ni las bya'o/ /mir 'gyur bsnyeni dka' ba ste/ /mi srog thob pa'ang dka' ba'i yin/ /dam pa'i chos thos dka' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ang dka' ba yin/ /bdag gis mir skye dka' ba yi/ /tshe thob pa ni g.yo zhing 'gyur/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang / /rgyal bsre)kun mkhyen bstan pa rnyed7)/ /lus kyi las dang ngag gi las/ /yid kyi las kyang sdig pa can/ /mi 'dod mi zad 8'bras bur 'gyur/ /phyin cadalo)spyad par mi bya'o/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa yi/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis7/ /'jig rten rab tu dka' spyod pa/ /bzang po dag gi las bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni byang chub phyir/ /bdag gi nyu7bla mar gang grags pa'i/ /bka' las 'da' bar mi bya ste/ /bsnyen bkur dag ni rab tu bya/ /lam ni drang po zhes bya ba/ /g.yo med pas ni rab bstan tshete/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni byang chub phyir / /sgyu mar 'gyur bar mi bya'o/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi 'jigs pa/ /de lta bur ni sems bskyed nas/ /snod gang tsam gyi chu yang 'bul/ /shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa lnga pa 'di bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs nyurteyongs su 7tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur byed de/ tha na chu bum pa gang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed de'i/ bdag yun ring por dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral zhing sdig pa'i grogs pos zin pas/ 'dud pa dang / rab tu 41—169

'dud pa dang / gus par smra ba dang 1)/ phyag bya ba dang / ldang ba dang /thal mo sbyar ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa med do/ /zhes de ltar mos pa'i bar gyis nga rgyal gyi na zil gyis non pas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mang po mngon par 'dus byas te/ mi dge ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas/ 'di lta ste/ mi'i nang du sbyin 5riganas thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba ma yin pa smad pa'i lus thob ste/'di lta bu'i sbyin gnas mnyes par ma byas pas na bder bdag mir gyur pa na/mi bkren pa dang / mi dbul po dang / bran du gyur pas3)dang / gzhan gyi dbang du song ba dang / 'dod pa la zhen pa'i sems can rnams dang /'dod pa la chags pa rnams dang / mi rigs pa'i spyod pa la gnas pa rnams dang ske/ log par lta ba rnams dang / tshul khrims log par zhugs pa rnams dang ske/ lta ba log par zhugs pa rnams dang / mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum la rab tu gnas pa rnams dang / 'gro bar bya ba ma yin pa'i 'gro ba bzhi lamatha'agro bar zhugs pa rnams dang / sgrib pa lngas bsgribs pa rnams dang / bla ma drug la gus par mi gnas pa rnams dang / dam pa'i chos ma yin pa bdun la 'jug pa rnams dang / log pa brgyad la log par nges pa rnams dang / gnod pa dgu'i dngos pos gnod par gyur pa rnams dang / mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la lam ngan par zhugs pa rnams dang / sems can dmyal ba'i lam la mngon par phyogs pa rnams dang / mtho ris kyi lam la ma phyogs pa rnams dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba rnams dang / sdig pa'i grogs po'i lag rishetu song ba rnams dang / bdud kyi dbang du song ba rnams dang / dge ba'i chos yongs su spangs pa rnams dang / mi dge ba'i chos la spyod pa rnams kyis nodabyug 41—170

pas bsdigs3)/ 'jigs pas bsdigs nas mi 'dod bzhin du byed cing rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur byed par gyur 5)te/ bdag gis ni da ltaram de dag mnyes par byas pas dge ba'i lus thob kyis 541sbyin gnas thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar bya'o/ /lus dang srog la mi lta ge)bar slob dpon la rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur bya'o zhes/ shā ri'i bu sems bskyed pa drug pa de bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur byed de/ tha na chu bum pa gang tsam yang 'bul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de nyid rgya cher rab tu rtog tu gzhug yipa'i phyir/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /sdig pa'i grogs ni nga rgyal rgyags 'phel ba/ /bskal pa mang po rgya mtshor bsten pas na/ / mi yi5nyanang du skyes kyang bran du 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i rgyun tu yun ring dus su 'khor/ /mi lus rab tu rnyed par dka' ba yang / /de ni bdag gis dka' ṅges shethob gyur te/ /gnas pa'i yul ni 'thun pa bzang po dang / /sangs rgyas 'byung dang dal 'byor de bzhin no/ /grogs po gang dag mchog tu rab bzang ba/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod dang lam ston cing ske/ /byang chub sems ni rin chen 9'phel byed pa/ /de dag bskal pa bye ba mang pos rnyed/ /lus ni nyam 7chung mi rtag mi brtan 17te/ /dbu 32ba rdos 1lhadang chu yi skochu bur 'dra/ /sgyu ma lta bu 15gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /rmi lam mthong dang 'drid tshepar smra ba bzhin/ /srog ni yun thung tshe yang zad par 'gyur / /ji ltar sprin dang glog ni mi gnas ltar/ /skad cig tu ni de bzhin srog kyang 'gyur/ /snying po med las 3 snying po len par byed/ /gang gis 'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa yang / /rgya mtsho brgya phrag bsam yas bslus gyur pa/ /nga 41—171

rgyal ri bo man dar 417)gzhom pa yi/ /dus dang tshod dang man ni nyer gnas kyis(5la/ /lus la sdug pa thams cad rab spangs nas/ /srog la chags pa med pa'i yid kyis ni/ /nga dang rgyags dang dregs pa spangs gyur nas/ /yon tan ldan la gus bcas rim gro bya/ /nga dang rgyags dnga' nadregs pa spangs gyur nas/ /pha dang ma dang bu pho pa/rnams dang ni/ /'jig rten bla ma mchog tu gang grags la / /gus dang bcas shing mchog gi rim gro bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /gang dag bdag dang byang chub 'thun spyod la/ /dga' dang gus pa brtan pa bskyed bya sten)/ /rim gro bya ba'i phyir ni brtson par bya/ /skye dgu neng rgyal ldan pa nga rgyal spangs/ /mi mkhas nga rgyal gcad cing gdul ba'i phyir/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bcom 2)byas nas/ /rgyags dang nga rgyal ri ni bsnyil59)bar bya/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byas te/ /byang chub snying po mchog la gnas gyur nas/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rtsod pa rnams btul 3 rite / /chu bo bzhi las srog chags bsgral bar bya/ /phyogs bcu 31dag na mi gang na ba rnams/ /rang gi mi gtsang bar lhung 1 smad pa la/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje'i yid kyis su/ /mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen 'gyur bar bya/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i dus la bab/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bslab pa bslabalgenus shes/ /bzod pa bsgom par bya ba phun sum tshogs/ /mdud pa med pa'i brtson 'grus brtsom ri7par bya/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin thob phun sum tshogs//sems gdul ba yi gdus ni nye bar gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab mkhas la gnas gyur te/ /bla ma thams cad la ni bskor ba bya/ /de ltar bsod nams stobs dang gzi brjid spel/ /shes rab ye shes mkhas pa bsam mi khyab/ /41—172

rang dbang dam pa dag gis mngon 'phags te/ /byur bur yongs su bkangatre①ba'i snod byinam no/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa drug pa 'di bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod yongs su tshol bas slob dpon la rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur byed de/ tha na chu bum pa gang tsamanyeyang 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed de/ bdag yun ring por dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral zhing sdig pa'i grogs po dang phrad pas le lo can/ brtson 'grus nyams pa/snyomadzagalas can/ blun pa/ lkugasapar gyur56)te/ las nag po dang57/ nag po'i rnam par smin pa 'ang med/ las dkar po dang / dkar po'i⑧rnam par smin pa'ang med/ las dkar gnagalo7dang / dkar gnag tshigi rnam par smin pa'ang med/ mi gnag51cing dkar ba'i las dang / mi gnag52cing dkar ba'i rnam par smin pa yang med do/ /zhes de ltar lta/ de ltar bzod/ de ltar mos pas/ dge sbyong dang0rte/ bram ze la/ btsun pa dag dge ba gang /mi dge ba gang / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang / kha na ma tho ba med pa gang ske/ 1stebasten par bya balgegang / bston par mi bya ba gang / bya ba'i rigs pa gang / bya ba'i mi rigs pa gang / ci byas na yun ring por gnod pa dang /mi phan pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur/ ci byas na don dang / phan pa dang ske/ bde bar 'gyur/ zhes mi 'dri ba dang / nga rgyal gyi lazil gyis non pas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mngon par 'dus byas te/ mi dge ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas 'di lta ste/ sbyin gnas thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba ma yin pa/dbang po ma tshang ba'i mir gyur nas 'di lta bu'i sbyin gnas mnyes par ma byas 41—173

pas / bdag mir gyur pa na yang long ba/ lkug pa/ blun pa/ rgyar0)ba/dig pa/ rmongs pa/ 'on par gyur te/ legs par bshad pa dang / nyes par bshad pa'i don shes par mi nus so/ /bdag gis ni da ltar mnyes par byas pas 'di lta ste/ dbang po tshang ba dge ba'i lus thob kyisami/ sbyin gnas thams cad kyi sku nye bar 'tsho bar ribya/ lus dang srog la mi blta gebar bya/legs par bshad pa dang / nyes par bshad pa'i don kun shes pa'i mthu yod par bya/ slob dpon la btsun pa dge ba gang / mi dge ba gang / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang / kha na ma tho ba med pa gang / bsten pa gang / mi bsten pa gang / bya ba gang / mi bya ba gang / ci byas na nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos mngon du 'gyur/ ci byas na byang chub sems dpa'i chos mngon du 'gyur zhes 'dri zhing byang chub sems dpa' 6)byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi don gyi phyir slob dpon la rim gro tshomechidang / bsnyen bkur byed de/ 'di ltar snying po med pa'i lus las snying po blang ngo snyam nas/ tha na chu bum pa gang tsam shegayang 'bul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 97de skad gsungs te/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad bka' stsal nas/ ston pa 7yang 'di skad gsung ngo / /phan pa 'dod phyir bskal pa brgya mang por/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs su spangs 17gyur nas/ /dge dang mi dge kha na ma tho dang / /kha na ma tho med byas nyurte'abras mi 'dri/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal dbang du 1 song ba ni/ /sems dmyal dud 'gro gshin rje'i dbang du song / /sdig sems grogs po bsten par byas pasatrebon / /bskal pa brgya mang gis mni ngan 'gror tsha'aphos/ / mi yi nyu 'jig rten dbang po ma tshang gyur/ /bskal pa stong phrag mang por 'khyams pa'i lus/ /41wa 174

dge dang mi dge kha na ma tho dang / /kha na ma tho med byas 'bras mi shes/ /rum1)sbal mgrin pa shing mig chud 'dra bar(ge/ /mi yi lus ni shin tu dka' bar thobani / /dbang po dag ni tshang zhing skye mched dge/ /mi dal yongs su spangs nas dal ba rnyed/ /'jig rten sgron ma mdzad pa mnyes byas nas/ /rgyal bas bstan chos7'dod chags bral ba thob/ /dge dang mi dge bya ba'itso)'bras bu dgayi /'jig rten gtso la bdag 'dri57dus la bab/ /'gro bar ser sna'i mir 'gyurasheji lta bu/ /ji ltar sbyin bdag ser sna med par 'gyur/ /ji ltar g.yo ngan brkam pa tshul khrims 'chal/ /tshul khrims nor kun srung〈nyeb ji lta bu / /mi ni khro dang 'khrug par ji ltar 'gyur/ /khro med bzod pa'i stobs su ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar le lo can dang g.yeng yid 'gyur/ /brtson 'phags bsam gtan dga' ba ji lta 'o bu/ /ji ltar 'chal pa'i shes rab blun lkug (lha'agyur / /ji ltar shes rab ldan zhing bden gtam dga'/ /ji ltar byang chub spyod balgegacigatsosems pas/ /spyod pa bzang po thams cad tshol bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'gro ba kun lam byams pa bgyid/ /ji ltar ngan song song ba'i sems can 'dren/ /ji ltar chos kyi dga' bas mi ngoms yid/ /byang chub spyod pa sde snod yongs su tshol/ /phyogs dang phyogs 'tshams nyinarab 'byam rtezhing rnams na/ /'jig rten bla ma bzhugs par ji ltar 'gro/ /phyag 'tshal bsod nams byed pa ji lta bu/ /kun tu bzang po 37spyod pa ci 'dra 'dri/ /slob dpon bla ma dag la bdag 'dri ba/ / de yi ni dus ni di du 1ring nyer 22gnas te/ /bla ma'i gnas su gi gnas las nyan dga' ste/ /slob dpon yid mgu byed pa ji lta bu/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi stesems ni〈2bskyed gyur nas/ /stobs dang bsod nams yangs ( 941—175
